title: Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent
title_zh: 以技能为中心的智能体推进临床基因组分析

paragraphs.en: Clinical genomic analysis requires experts to integrate evolving guidelines, databases, and computational evidence. As sequencing has become increasingly accessible, this complex and labor-intensive process has become a major bottleneck to the timely use of genomic information in clinical decision-making. To fill this gap, we developed ClinGeX , a large-language-model agent that composes 105 curated executable skills through task-specific retrieval and dependency-aware orchestration. On 223 temporally held-out benchmark cases, ClinGeX achieved 71.7% macro-averaged task-level concordance with expert reference classifications, compared with 45.7% for the strongest comparator. In a three-condition, counterbalanced human-AI collaboration study, 45 clinical genomic professionals assessed 135 clinically derived cases under routine (no AI assistance), DeepSeek-assisted and ClinGeX-assisted conditions. ClinGeX assistance increased raw case-level concordance across criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making (51.1%, 57.8%, 64.4% versus 15.6%, 31.1%, 20.0% in comparator conditions) and reduced reported interpretation time in all scenarios. During an exploratory one-month real-world non-interventional assessment, 11 experienced professionals submitted feedback on 96 self-selected analysis episodes and reported frequent conclusion adoption and time savings. These findings support executable domain skills as a promising approach to augment specialist genomic interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 临床基因组分析需要专家整合不断更新的指南、数据库和计算证据。 随着测序日益普及，这一复杂且劳动密集的过程已成为基因组信息及时用于临床决策的主要瓶颈。 为填补这一空白，我们开发了 ClinGeX，一个大语言模型智能体，它通过任务特定的检索和依赖感知的编排，组合了105个经过精心整理的可执行技能。 在223个时间上留出的基准测试案例中，ClinGeX 与专家参考分类在任务层面达到71.7%的宏平均一致性，而最强的对照方法仅为45.7%。 在一项三条件、平衡顺序的人机协作研究中，45名临床基因组专业人员在常规（无AI辅助）、DeepSeek 辅助和 ClinGeX 辅助三种条件下评估了135个源于临床的案例。 ClinGeX 辅助提高了原始案例层面在标准层面变异分析、罕见病基因组解读和分子肿瘤学决策上的一致性（分别为51.1%、57.8%、64.4%，对照条件下为15.6%、31.1%、20.0%），并在所有场景中缩短了报告的解读时间。 在为期一个月的探索性真实世界非干预性评估中，11名经验丰富的专业人员就96个自选分析事件提交了反馈，并报告了频繁采纳结论及节省时间的情况。 这些发现支持可执行领域技能作为增强专业基因组解读的一种有前景的方法。

paragraphs.en: Genomic analysis has become an increasingly central component of modern precision medicine, particularly in rare disease and cancer [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Advances in high-throughput sequencing have enabled the systematic characterization of genetic variation at unprecedented scale, facilitating molecular diagnosis, disease classification, patient stratification, and the identification of targeted therapeutic opportunities [ 4 , 5 , 2 , 3 ] . Yet, as sequencing has become increasingly accessible, the major bottleneck in genomic medicine has shifted from data generation to the interpretation of genetic variation and the derivation of clinically actionable insights [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] , a challenge famously framed as the “$1,000 genome, $100,000 analysis” [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基因组分析已成为现代精准医学中日益核心的组成部分，尤其是在罕见病和癌症领域 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 高通量测序技术的进步使得对遗传变异进行前所未有规模的系统性刻画成为可能，促进了分子诊断、疾病分类、患者分层以及靶向治疗机会的识别 [ 4 , 5 , 2 , 3 ] 。 然而，随着测序变得日益普及，基因组医学的主要瓶颈已从数据生成转向遗传变异的解读以及临床可行动见解的推导 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] ，这一挑战被著名地概括为「1,000美元基因组，100,000美元分析」[ 10 ] 。

sents.en: Genomic analysis has become an increasingly central component of modern precision medicine, particularly in rare disease and cancer [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
sents.zh: 基因组分析已成为现代精准医学中日益核心的组成部分，尤其是在罕见病和癌症领域 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。

sents.en: Yet, as sequencing has become increasingly accessible, the major bottleneck in genomic medicine has shifted from data generation to the interpretation of genetic variation and the derivation of clinically actionable insights [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] , a challenge famously framed as the “$1,000 genome, $100,000 analysis” [ 10 ] .
sents.zh: 然而，随着测序变得日益普及，基因组医学的主要瓶颈已从数据生成转向遗传变异的解读以及临床可行动见解的推导 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] ，这一挑战被著名地概括为「1,000美元基因组，100,000美元分析」[ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: This bottleneck arises from three challenges: ( i ) fragmented evidence : relevant knowledge is distributed across heterogeneous and often siloed sources, including variant databases, biomedical literature, clinical guidelines, and patient phenotypes; ( ii ) expertise-intensive reasoning : assessing variant significance demands substantial domain knowledge and contextual judgment involving disease mechanisms, inheritance patterns, phenotypic context, and evidence strength; and ( iii ) dynamic analytical workflows : different patients and questions entail adaptive combinations of variant annotation, phenotype matching, evidence retrieval, pathogenicity assessment, and result synthesis. As a result, although conventional bioinformatics tools can automate individual steps [ 11 , 12 ] , performing a comprehensive genomic analysis still relies heavily on experts to integrate disparate information and synthesize actionable conclusions, limiting its scalability.
paragraphs.zh: 这一瓶颈源于三方面的挑战：（一）证据碎片化：相关知识分散于异构且往往彼此孤立的数据源中，包括变异位点数据库、生物医学文献、临床指南以及患者表型；（二）推理高度依赖专业知识：评估变异位点的意义需要大量的领域知识和情境判断，涉及疾病机制、遗传模式、表型背景以及证据强度；（三）分析流程动态多变：不同的患者和问题需要灵活组合变异位点注释、表型匹配、证据检索、致病性评估与结果综合等步骤。 因此，尽管传统的生物信息学工具可以自动执行单个步骤 [11, 12]，进行全面的基因组分析仍然严重依赖专家来整合分散的信息并综合出可操作的结论，这限制了其可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: Recently, large language model (LLM)-based agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating similar knowledge-intensive clinical tasks by combining reasoning with information retrieval and tool use [ 13 , 14 ] . Bringing this paradigm to genomic analysis, however, is non-trivial. The field relies on a vast and continuously evolving ecosystem of professional guidelines, databases, and computational tools, each with distinct formats, interfaces, and usage protocols [ 15 , 16 ] . Systematically translating these heterogeneous resources into standardized, agent-operable capabilities within a unified, scalable “agent harness” is therefore a central design problem [ 17 ] . Crucially, such a harness must preserve the flexibility of LLMs to dynamically compose workflows for diverse clinical questions, while ensuring that individual analyses follow established domain-specific procedures and standards.
paragraphs.zh: 近来，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体已成为通过将推理与信息检索及工具使用相结合，来自动化类似知识密集型临床任务的有前景的范式 [ 13 , 14 ] 。然而，将这一范式应用于基因组分析并非易事。该领域依赖于一个庞大且持续演进的专业指南、数据库和计算工具生态系统，每个资源都具有不同的格式、接口和使用协议 [ 15 , 16 ] 。因此，在一个统一、可扩展的“智能体框架”（agent harness）内，将这些异构资源系统性地转化为标准化的、可由智能体操作的能力，是一个核心设计问题 [ 17 ] 。至关重要的是，这样的框架必须保留大语言模型动态组合工作流以应对多样化临床问题的灵活性，同时确保每项分析都遵循既定的领域特定程序和标准。

paragraphs.en: Here, we present ClinGeX , a skill-centred agentic framework designed to support and accelerate clinical genomic analysis across heterogeneous inputs, including free text, pedigree images, clinical documents and sequencing data. ClinGeX comprises 105 specialized skills , each encoding an atomic operation in clinical genomics. These skills span five recurring categories: guideline following, entity mapping, data-source lookup, numerical calculation and model-based prediction. In the deployed system, they are grouped by operational role into three functional classes —guide, search and analysis. Together, they transform heterogeneous genomic resources into standardized capabilities that an LLM agent can combine for different clinical questions. Methodologically, we developed the skill library and system workflow through six stages : broad scanning of domain resources; LLM-assisted prioritization and expert selection; iterative skill development and testing; graph-based organization of related skills and their prerequisites; task-specific retrieval and progressive disclosure of skill instructions; and integration of multimodal inputs into an online interface. At inference , this organization enables the system to start from skills matched to a request, add their prerequisites and expose detailed instructions only when needed, limiting irrelevant context while preserving flexible workflows. This process converts established guidelines, databases and analytical tools into executable skills, while allowing ClinGeX to retrieve and compose only the capabilities required for each analysis (Fig. 1 b).
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们介绍 ClinGeX，这是一个以技能为中心的智能体框架，旨在支持和加速跨异构输入（包括自由文本、家系图图像、临床文档和测序数据）的临床基因组分析。 ClinGeX 包含 105 个专门化技能，每个技能编码临床基因组学中的一个原子操作。 这些技能涵盖五个反复出现的类别：指南遵循、实体映射、数据源查询、数值计算和基于模型的预测。 在部署的系统中，它们按操作角色被归入三个功能类别——引导、检索和分析。 它们共同将异构的基因组资源转化为标准化的能力，供大语言模型智能体组合使用以应对不同的临床问题。 在方法学上，我们通过六个阶段开发了技能库和系统工作流：对领域资源进行广泛扫描；借助大语言模型进行优先级排序并由专家遴选；迭代式技能开发与测试；以图谱形式组织相关技能及其前置条件；面向具体任务的检索与技能说明的渐进式披露；以及将多模态输入整合到在线界面中。 在推理时，这种组织方式使系统能够从与请求匹配的技能出发，添加其前置条件，并仅在需要时才展示详细说明，从而在保留灵活工作流的同时限制无关上下文。 该过程将既有的指南、数据库和分析工具转化为可执行的技能，同时使 ClinGeX 能够仅检索和组合每次分析所需的能力（图 1b）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate both the performance and clinical utility of ClinGeX, we conducted two independent studies. We assessed its autonomous analytical performance across 223 cases against OpenAI DeepResearch [ 18 ] , representing a state-of-the-art commercial general-purpose research system, and Biomni [ 19 ] , a leading open-source biomedical agent from academia. ClinGeX substantially outperformed both systems, achieving 71.7% concordance with expert consensus, 26.0 percentage points above the strongest comparator; moreover, 74.9% of its reports were judged directly adoptable without substantial revision by senior physicians, exceeding both comparators by more than 40 percentage points. More importantly , to determine whether these capabilities could translate into meaningful support for clinicians, we conducted a randomized multicentre study involving 45 clinical genomic professionals from three medical centres and 135 retrospectively collected real-world cases spanning criterion-level variant analysis , genomic interpretation in rare disease , and molecular oncology decision-making (Fig. 1 c). DeepSeek 1 1 1 Official website: https://chat.deepseek.com/ [ 20 ] was included as an accessible and representative example of widely used general-purpose LLM assistants. ClinGeX-assisted clinicians achieved significantly higher case-level concordance across all three scenarios, reaching 51.1% , 57.8% , and 64.4% , compared with 22.2%, 28.9%, and 31.1% for clinicians-only and 15.6%, 31.1%, and 20.0% with DeepSeek assistance. ClinGeX assistance also improved evidence identification and reduced the median time for criterion-level variant analysis from 60 to 15 minutes . Together, these findings support ClinGeX as a potential “Co-Clinician” [ 21 , 22 ] , augmenting rather than replacing expert genomic decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估 ClinGeX 的性能与临床实用性，我们开展了两项独立研究。 我们在 223 个病例上评估了其自主分析性能，并与 OpenAI DeepResearch [ 18 ]（代表最先进的商业通用研究系统）和 Biomni [ 19 ]（来自学术界的领先开源生物医学智能体）进行比较。 ClinGeX 显著优于这两个系统，与专家共识的一致性达到 71.7%，比最强对照高出 26.0 个百分点；此外，其 74.9% 的报告被资深医师判定为无需大幅修改即可直接采用，比两个对照高出 40 多个百分点。 更重要的是，为确定这些能力能否转化为对临床医师有意义的支持，我们开展了一项随机多中心研究，纳入来自三个医疗中心的 45 名临床基因组专业人员以及 135 例回顾性收集的真实世界病例，涵盖标准层面的变异分析、罕见病的基因组解读以及分子肿瘤学决策（图 1c）。 DeepSeek 1 1 1 官方网站：https://chat.deepseek.com/ [ 20 ] 作为广泛使用的通用大语言模型助手的一个易获取且具代表性的示例被纳入研究。 借助 ClinGeX 的临床医师在所有三种场景中均达到了显著更高的病例级一致性，分别达到 51.1%、57.8% 和 64.4%，而仅由临床医师完成时分别为 22.2%、28.9% 和 31.1%，借助 DeepSeek 时分别为 15.6%、31.1% 和 20.0%。 ClinGeX 辅助还改善了证据识别，并将标准层面变异分析的中位时间从 60 分钟缩短至 15 分钟。 综上所述，这些发现支持 ClinGeX 作为潜在的「协同临床医师」[ 21 , 22 ]，即增强而非取代专家的基因组决策。

sents.en: ClinGeX substantially outperformed both systems, achieving 71.7% concordance with expert consensus, 26.0 percentage points above the strongest comparator; moreover, 74.9% of its reports were judged directly adoptable without substantial revision by senior physicians, exceeding both comparators by more than 40 percentage points.

sents.en: More importantly , to determine whether these capabilities could translate into meaningful support for clinicians, we conducted a randomized multicentre study involving 45 clinical genomic professionals from three medical centres and 135 retrospectively collected real-world cases spanning criterion-level variant analysis , genomic interpretation in rare disease , and molecular oncology decision-making (Fig. 1 c).
sents.zh: 更重要的是，为确定这些能力能否转化为对临床医师有意义的支持，我们开展了一项随机多中心研究，纳入来自三个医疗中心的 45 名临床基因组专业人员以及 135 例回顾性收集的真实世界病例，涵盖标准层面的变异分析、罕见病的基因组解读以及分子肿瘤学决策（图 1c）。

sents.en: DeepSeek 1 1 1 Official website: https://chat.deepseek.com/ [ 20 ] was included as an accessible and representative example of widely used general-purpose LLM assistants.
sents.zh: DeepSeek 1 1 1 官方网站：https://chat.deepseek.com/ [ 20 ] 作为广泛使用的通用大语言模型助手的一个易获取且具代表性的示例被纳入研究。

sents.en: ClinGeX-assisted clinicians achieved significantly higher case-level concordance across all three scenarios, reaching 51.1% , 57.8% , and 64.4% , compared with 22.2%, 28.9%, and 31.1% for clinicians-only and 15.6%, 31.1%, and 20.0% with DeepSeek assistance.
sents.zh: 借助 ClinGeX 的临床医师在所有三种场景中均达到了显著更高的病例级一致性，分别达到 51.1%、57.8% 和 64.4%，而仅由临床医师完成时分别为 22.2%、28.9% 和 31.1%，借助 DeepSeek 时分别为 15.6%、31.1% 和 20.0%。

sents.en: ClinGeX assistance also improved evidence identification and reduced the median time for criterion-level variant analysis from 60 to 15 minutes .
sents.zh: ClinGeX 辅助还改善了证据识别，并将标准层面变异分析的中位时间从 60 分钟缩短至 15 分钟。

sents.en: Together, these findings support ClinGeX as a potential “Co-Clinician” [ 21 , 22 ] , augmenting rather than replacing expert genomic decision-making.
sents.zh: 综上所述，这些发现支持 ClinGeX 作为潜在的「协同临床医师」[ 21 , 22 ]，即增强而非取代专家的基因组决策。

paragraphs.en: Finally, to preliminarily assess its utility in routine clinical-genomics work, we evaluated ClinGeX over a prespecified one-month period of routine use, during which 11 experienced clinical genomics professionals from multiple medical centers used the system for self-directed, naturally occurring tasks and provided structured feedback on 96 completed analyses (Fig. 1 d). Experts reported fully or partially adopting ClinGeX’s conclusions in 94.8% of tasks, while time savings of more than 15 minutes were reported for 77.3% of difficult tasks. Together, these complementary evaluations support the potential of a skill-centred, domain-grounded agent to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and practical scalability of clinical genomic analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，为初步评估其在常规临床基因组学工作中的实用性，我们在预先设定的为期一个月的常规使用期内对 ClinGeX 进行了评估，在此期间，来自多个医学中心的 11 位经验丰富的临床基因组学专业人员将该系统用于自主发起的、自然发生的任务，并针对 96 次已完成的分析提供了结构化反馈（图 1d）。 专家报告称，在 94.8% 的任务中完全或部分采纳了 ClinGeX 的结论，同时报告在 77.3% 的困难任务中节省了超过 15 分钟的时间。 综合来看，这些互补性的评估结果支持以技能为中心、以领域知识为基础的智能体在提升临床基因组分析的准确性、效率及实际可扩展性方面的潜力。

paragraphs.en: ClinGeX is an LLM-driven agent for clinical genomic analysis. Through a chatbot interface (Fig. 1 a), users can submit free-text requests together with optional multimodal materials, including pedigree images, clinical records and other file types. The system returns a free-text reports accompanied by a concise summary of the analytical workflow, evidence sources and key intermediate outputs to support traceability.
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 是一个用于临床基因组分析的大语言模型驱动的智能体。 通过聊天机器人界面（图 1a），用户可以提交自由文本请求，并附上可选的多模态材料，包括家系图图像、临床记录及其他文件类型。 系统返回自由文本报告，并附带分析流程、证据来源和关键中间输出的简明摘要，以支持可追溯性。

sents.en: ClinGeX is an LLM-driven agent for clinical genomic analysis.

sents.en: The system returns a free-text reports accompanied by a concise summary of the analytical workflow, evidence sources and key intermediate outputs to support traceability.

paragraphs.en: At its core, ClinGeX uses a skill-centred architecture comprising 105 atomic clinical-genomics skills. For each request, a skill selector decomposes the task, retrieves relevant skills and expands the selection using semantic and prerequisite relationships encoded in a skill graph. The agent then executes the resulting task-specific workflow iteratively and synthesizes the accumulated evidence into its final response. Actions and tool outputs are retained in the execution record for review. Further details of the system architecture and development are provided in Methods Sec. 4.1 .
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 的核心采用以技能为中心的架构，包含 105 个原子化的临床基因组学技能。 对于每个请求，技能选择器会分解任务，检索相关技能，并利用技能图谱中编码的语义关系与前置关系来扩展所选技能。 智能体随后迭代执行由此生成的针对特定任务的工作流，并将积累的证据综合到最终回复中。 操作和工具输出会保留在执行记录中以供审查。 系统架构与开发的更多细节见方法第 4.1 节。

paragraphs.en: We next evaluated ClinGeX across three settings of increasing clinical realism: automated system benchmarks, a controlled human–AI collaboration study, and prospective assessment in real-world clinical-genomics use. Together, these evaluations examined standalone performance, effects on clinician performance, and perceived utility in routine workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们在临床真实性递增的三种情境下对 ClinGeX 进行了评估：自动化系统基准测试、一项受控的人机协作研究，以及在真实世界临床基因组学应用中的前瞻性评估。 这些评估共同考察了独立性能、对临床医生工作表现的影响，以及在常规工作流程中感知到的实用性。

sents.en: We next evaluated ClinGeX across three settings of increasing clinical realism: automated system benchmarks, a controlled human–AI collaboration study, and prospective assessment in real-world clinical-genomics use.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们在临床真实性递增的三种情境下对 ClinGeX 进行了评估：自动化系统基准测试、一项受控的人机协作研究，以及在真实世界临床基因组学应用中的前瞻性评估。

sents.en: Together, these evaluations examined standalone performance, effects on clinician performance, and perceived utility in routine workflows.
sents.zh: 这些评估共同考察了独立性能、对临床医生工作表现的影响，以及在常规工作流程中感知到的实用性。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate ClinGeX at scale, we constructed a benchmark comprising 223 clinical-genomics cases released after the knowledge cutoff of the underlying model of the comparators, collected from five expert-curated resources: ClinVar [ 23 ] for SNV interpretation (n=79), ClinGen [ 24 , 25 ] for gene–disease validity assessment (n=66), and CIViC [ 26 , 27 ] , OncoKB [ 28 , 29 ] and PharmGKB [ 30 ] for clinical-actionability classification (n=78). The primary metric was final-answer concordance, defined as agreement with all required components of the reference standard. Shared secondary outcomes included repeat consistency and execution time. Task-specific outcomes assessed pathogenicity discrimination and evidence recovery for SNV interpretation; classification severity and genetic and experimental evidence coverage for gene–disease validity; and complete-answer accuracy and classification severity for clinical actionability. Exact definitions, denominators and scoring procedures are provided in Supplementary Sec. A.4 . To assess potential leakage from the reference databases, we audited execution records for direct or indirect retrieval of source information and confirmed that no evaluated execution retrieved such information (Supplementary Table 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为在大规模下评估 ClinGeX，我们构建了一个包含223个临床基因组学案例的基准，这些案例发布于对比方法所基于模型的知识截止日期之后，收集自五个由专家整理的资源：ClinVar [23] 用于SNV解读（n=79），ClinGen [24,25] 用于基因-疾病有效性评估（n=66），以及 CIViC [26,27]、OncoKB [28,29] 和 PharmGKB [30] 用于临床可操作性分类（n=78）。 主要指标为最终答案一致性，其定义为与参考标准的所有必需组成部分相一致。 共同的次要结局包括重复一致性和执行时间。 任务特异性结局评估的内容包括：SNV解读的致病性判别和证据恢复；基因-疾病有效性评估的分类严重程度以及遗传和实验证据覆盖度；临床可操作性评估的完整答案准确率和分类严重程度。 精确定义、分母和评分程序见补充材料 A.4 节。 为评估来自参考数据库的潜在信息泄露，我们审查了执行记录中对源信息的直接或间接检索，并确认没有任何被评估的执行检索到此类信息（补充表6）。

A.5 and A.6 , we conducted ablation studies to assess the contribution of the ClinGeX architecture and its robustness across different agent cores. Here, we used the final ClinGeX configuration with DeepSeek-V4 as the agent core and compared it with the domain-specialized OpenBioLLM [ 31 ] and the latest agents, DeepResearch (OpenAI) [ 18 ] , SciSpace [ 32 ] , Biomni [ 19 ] and TxAgent [ 33 ] . paragraphs.en: ClinGeX outperforms domain-specialized LLMs and agents across all three tasks.
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 在所有三项任务上的表现均优于领域专用的 LLM 和智能体。

paragraphs.en: ClinGeX achieved the highest final concordance in each task (Fig. 2 a–c): 89.9% for SNV interpretation, 53.0% for gene–disease validity and 72.3% for clinical actionability. The corresponding best baseline results were 49.4% for DeepResearch, 35.5% for Biomni and 52.3% for TxAgent. Repeat consistency remained high across the three tasks (87.9–93.7%). Mean execution time was 175–197,s, broadly comparable to other agentic systems and shorter than SciSpace (496–727,s).
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 在每项任务中都取得了最高的最终一致性（图 2 a–c）：SNV 解读为 89.9%，基因–疾病有效性为 53.0%，临床可操作性为 72.3%。 相应的最佳基线结果分别是：DeepResearch 为 49.4%，Biomni 为 35.5%，TxAgent 为 52.3%。 三项任务的重复一致性均保持较高水平（87.9–93.7%）。 平均执行时间为 175–197,s，与其他智能体系统大致相当，且低于 SciSpace（496–727,s）。

paragraphs.en: For SNV interpretation, ClinGeX achieved 100% sensitivity and 92.4% specificity for pathogenicity identification, with 82.3% weighted evidence recall, 84.8% evidence-strength concordance and a 1.3% significant-error rate. In gene–disease validity assessment, it reported usable genetic and experimental evidence scores for 90.9% of cases, compared with 28.8% and 15.2%, respectively, for the strongest comparator. For clinical-actionability classification, complete-answer accuracy was 57.7%, compared with 26.9% for TxAgent, while severe over- and under-classification remained infrequent.
paragraphs.zh: 在SNV解读方面，ClinGeX在致病性识别上达到了100%的敏感性和92.4%的特异性，加权证据召回率为82.3%，证据强度一致率为84.8%，显著错误率为1.3%。 在基因–疾病有效性评估中，ClinGeX为90.9%的病例给出了可用的遗传和实验证据评分，而最强对比方法分别为28.8%和15.2%。 在临床可操作性分类方面，完整答案准确率为57.7%，而TxAgent为26.9%，同时严重的高估和低估分类仍然少见。

paragraphs.en: ClinGeX produces higher-quality and more clinically usable reports in blinded expert review.

paragraphs.en: We additionally compared the free-text reports produced by ClinGeX, Biomni and DeepResearch with human rating, jointly considering the correctness of key results and the soundness of the reasoning. Within each task, cases were partitioned among three domain experts (nine experts in total), each of whom rated the three shuffled and de-identified system reports for their assigned cases. Reports were evaluated on three-level ordinal dimensions covering overall acceptability, required revision, citation accuracy, guideline adherence, evidence use and interpretation, fabricated content and potential clinical risk (Fig. 2 d; Supplementary Sec. A.4.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们还进一步将 ClinGeX、Biomni 和 DeepResearch 生成的自由文本报告与人类评分进行了比较，综合考虑关键结果的正确性以及推理的合理性。 在每项任务内，案例被分配给三位领域专家（共九位专家），每位专家对其所分配案例的三个经过打乱且去标识化的系统报告进行评分。 报告从多个三级序数维度进行评估，包括总体可接受性、所需修改、引用准确性、指南遵循度、证据使用与解读、捏造内容以及潜在临床风险（图 2d；补充材料第 A.4.7 节）。

paragraphs.en: The proportion of ClinGeX reports receiving the highest overall-acceptability rating was 88.6% for SNV interpretation, 66.7% for gene–disease validity and 67.9% for clinical actionability. The corresponding proportions were 32.9%, 40.9% and 23.1% for DeepResearch and 34.2%, 43.9% and 17.9% for Biomni. ClinGeX received higher ratings across all assessed dimensions in the first two tasks. In clinical-actionability classification, its clearest advantages were in overall acceptability, guideline adherence, evidence completeness and evidence interpretation, whereas citation accuracy and avoidance of fabrication were similar across systems. These findings suggest that the performance advantage of ClinGeX extends beyond final classification to the quality and usability of its supporting analysis.
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 报告获得最高总体可接受性评级的比例在 SNV 解读中为 88.6%，在基因-疾病有效性评估中为 66.7%，在临床可操作性评估中为 67.9%。 DeepResearch 的相应比例分别为 32.9%、40.9% 和 23.1%，Biomni 的相应比例分别为 34.2%、43.9% 和 17.9%。 在前两项任务中，ClinGeX 在所有评估维度上的评分均更高。 在临床可操作性分类中，其最明显的优势体现在总体可接受性、指南依从性、证据完整性和证据解读方面，而引文准确性和避免捏造在各系统之间相近。 这些结果表明，ClinGeX 的性能优势不仅体现在最终分类上，还体现在其支持性分析的质量和可用性上。

paragraphs.en: ClinGeX can ground its classifications in guideline-consistent analysis.
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 能够将其分类建立在符合指南的分析基础上。

paragraphs.en: To more directly illustrate its capability, we selected three cases in which ClinGeX matched the reference classification while Biomni and DeepResearch did not (Fig. 3 ). In a SNV interpretation case, ClinGeX weighted two complementary functional studies against a discordant computational prediction without over-crediting it, reaching Likely Pathogenic where both comparators reported Pathogenic. In another gene-disease validity case, it partitioned genetic and experimental support into explicit, separately scored criteria, supporting a Limited classification where Biomni and DeepResearch reported Moderate and Definitive, respectively. In a clinical actionability case, it distinguished short-term glucose-response from longer-term HbA1c endpoints and weighed replication across overlapping cohorts, reaching Level 3 where the comparators reported Level 2A and Level 2B. In each case, the figure traces the classification to specific, guideline-grounded analytical steps that the comparators omitted, together illustrating ClinGeX’s capacity for integrative synthesis of heterogeneous evidence and for discriminating among evidentiary sources of differing strength.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更直接地展示其能力，我们选取了三个 ClinGeX 得出与参考分类一致的结果、而 Biomni 和 DeepResearch 未能做到的案例（图 3 ）。 在一个 SNV 解读案例中，ClinGeX 将两项互补的功能研究置于一个不一致的计算预测之上进行权衡，且未过度采信后者，得出「可能致病（Likely Pathogenic）」，而两个对比方法均报告为「致病（Pathogenic）」。 在另一个基因-疾病有效性案例中，它将遗传学证据与实验证据分解为明确且分别评分的标准，支持「有限（Limited）」分类，而 Biomni 和 DeepResearch 分别报告为「中等（Moderate）」和「确定（Definitive）」。 在一个临床可操作性案例中，它区分了短期血糖反应与较长期的 HbA1c 终点，并权衡了重叠队列间的重复验证，得出「3 级（Level 3）」，而对比方法分别报告为「2A 级（Level 2A）」和「2B 级（Level 2B）」。 在每个案例中，该图都将分类结果追溯到对比方法所遗漏的、基于指南的具体分析步骤，共同体现了 ClinGeX 对异质性证据进行整合综合的能力，以及在不同强度的证据来源之间加以甄别的能力。

paragraphs.en: We next conducted a three-centre, multi-reader multi-case (MRMC) study to assess whether ClinGeX could improve human performance in three clinical-genomics scenarios: criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making. Each scenario comprised 45 cases, yielding 135 cases in total. Fifteen clinical genomic professionals with 3–10 years of relevant experience participated in each scenario (45 participants overall), with one scenario evaluated at each of three centres: Xinhua Hospital; the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Faculty of Medicine, CUHK; and Shanghai Chest Hospital. Participants completed cases under three conditions: human-only, DeepSeek-aided and ClinGeX-aided. DeepSeek was selected as an accessible and widely used general-purpose LLM comparator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们随后开展了一项三中心、多读者多病例（MRMC）研究，以评估 ClinGeX 能否在三个临床基因组学场景中提升人类的表现：标准层面的变异分析、罕见病的基因组解读以及分子肿瘤学决策。 每个场景包含 45 个病例，共计 135 个病例。 每个场景有 15 名具有 3–10 年相关经验的临床基因组学专业人员参与（共计 45 名参与者），三个场景分别在三个中心进行评估：新华医院；香港中文大学医学院妇产科；以及上海市胸科医院。 参与者在三种条件下完成病例：仅人工、DeepSeek 辅助和 ClinGeX 辅助。 选择 DeepSeek 作为一种易于获取且广泛使用的通用大语言模型对照。

paragraphs.en: A Latin-square-inspired counterbalanced design minimized learning and order effects [ 34 ] (Extended Data Fig. 2 ). Each participant completed nine cases—three per condition—without encountering the same case twice. Each case was evaluated under all three conditions by three different participants, and condition order was randomized across participants. Further details are provided in Methods Sec. 4.2 .

paragraphs.en: ClinGeX assistance is associated with higher case-level concordance.
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 辅助与更高的病例级别一致性相关。

paragraphs.en: We first assessed whether ClinGeX could improve participants’ final-answer correctness. We used case-level concordance as the primary metric, defined as the proportion of assessments for which the participant’s final conclusion was adjudicated by the expert panel as substantially correct (Supplementary Sec. A.7.2 ). ClinGeX assistance produced the highest concordance in all three scenarios (Fig. 4 a). For criterion-level variant analysis, observed concordance was 51.1%, compared with 22.2% under human-only assessment and 15.6% with DeepSeek assistance; the corresponding GLMM-standardized differences were 29.9 percentage points (Holm-adjusted P = 0.013 P=0.013 ) and 36.8 points ( P = 0.009 P=0.009 ), respectively. For genomic interpretation in rare disease, observed concordance was 57.8%, compared with 28.9% and 31.1%, respectively; the GLMM-standardized differences were 29.6 points ( P = 0.017 P=0.017 ) and 27.3 points ( P = 0.019 P=0.019 ). For molecular oncology decision-making, observed concordance was 64.4%, compared with 31.1% and 20.0%, respectively; the GLMM-standardized differences were 33.4 points ( P = 0.002 P=0.002 ) and 44.5 points ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ). Thus, under the current analysis, ClinGeX assistance approximately doubled concordance relative to routine and DeepSeek-aided assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先评估了 ClinGeX 能否提高参与者的最终答案正确率。 我们以病例级一致性作为主要指标，其定义为：参与者的最终结论被专家组裁定为基本正确的评估所占比例（补充材料第 A.7.2 节）。 在所有三个场景中，ClinGeX 辅助均产生了最高的一致性（图 4a）。 在标准层面的变异分析中，观察到的临床一致性为 51.1%，而仅人工评估为 22.2%，DeepSeek 辅助为 15.6%；相应的 GLMM 标准化差异分别为 29.9 个百分点（Holm 校正 P = 0.013）和 36.8 个百分点（P = 0.009）。 在罕见病的基因组解读中，观察到的临床一致性为 57.8%，而两组对照分别为 28.9% 和 31.1%；GLMM 标准化差异分别为 29.6 个百分点（P = 0.017）和 27.3 个百分点（P = 0.019）。 在分子肿瘤学决策中，观察到的临床一致性为 64.4%，而两组对照分别为 31.1% 和 20.0%；GLMM 标准化差异分别为 33.4 个百分点（P = 0.002）和 44.5 个百分点（P < 0.001）。 因此，在当前分析中，ClinGeX 辅助相对于常规评估和 DeepSeek 辅助评估，大约使一致性提高了一倍。

paragraphs.en: ClinGeX assistance improves key components of the supporting analysis.
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 辅助功能提升了支持性分析的关键组成部分。

paragraphs.en: We next evaluated task-specific intermediate outcomes, including evidence identification and weighting, phenotype interpretation and clinical-actionability assessment. Specifically, criterion-level variant analysis was evaluated using ACMG/AMP evidence recall, unsupported-evidence assignment, evidence-strength concordance, final-class accuracy and directional classification errors; genomic interpretation in rare disease using variant-classification and phenotype-interpretation accuracy and directional errors; and molecular oncology decision-making using panel-adjudicated free-response accuracy and the accuracy and directional errors of clinical-appropriateness judgements (Supplementary Sec. A.7.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们评估了任务特定的中间结果，包括证据识别与权重赋值、表型解读以及临床可操作性评估。 具体而言，标准层面的变异分析通过 ACMG/AMP 证据召回率、无支持证据的判定、证据强度一致性、最终分类准确性以及方向性分类错误来评估；罕见病的基因组解读通过变异分类和表型解读的准确性及方向性错误来评估；分子肿瘤学决策则通过专家组裁定的自由回答准确性以及临床恰当性判断的准确性和方向性错误来评估（补充材料第 A.7.3 节）。

A.7.3 ).
sents.zh: 具体而言，标准层面的变异分析通过 ACMG/AMP 证据召回率、无支持证据的判定、证据强度一致性、最终分类准确性以及方向性分类错误来评估；罕见病的基因组解读通过变异分类和表型解读的准确性及方向性错误来评估；分子肿瘤学决策则通过专家组裁定的自由回答准确性以及临床恰当性判断的准确性和方向性错误来评估（补充材料第 A.7.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: In criterion-level variant analysis (Fig. 4 b), ClinGeX increased model-standardized ACMG/AMP evidence recall by 28.6 (percentage) points relative to human-only assessment and by 27.9 points relative to DeepSeek assistance (both P < 0.001 P<0.001 ). It reduced unsupported evidence assignments by 10.4 ( P = 0.009 P=0.009 ) and 15.3 points ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ), respectively, and improved evidence-strength concordance by 9.9 ( P = 0.015 P=0.015 ) and 20.2 points ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ). Final pathogenicity-classification accuracy was 23.1 points higher than with DeepSeek assistance ( P = 0.040 P=0.040 ), and over-classification was reduced by 9.2 and 11.1 points relative to human-only and DeepSeek-aided assessment, respectively (both P = 0.034 P=0.034 ); the remaining directional contrasts were not statistically significant.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准层级的变异分析中（图4b），相对于仅人工评估，ClinGeX 将模型标准化 ACMG/AMP 证据的召回率提高了 28.6 个百分点，相对于 DeepSeek 辅助提高了 27.9 个百分点（两者 P < 0.001 P<0.001 ）。 相应地，它将无支持证据的判定分别减少了 10.4 个百分点（ P = 0.009 P=0.009 ）和 15.3 个百分点（ P < 0.001 P<0.001 ），并将证据强度的一致性分别提高了 9.9 个百分点（ P = 0.015 P=0.015 ）和 20.2 个百分点（ P < 0.001 P<0.001 ）。 最终致病性分类的准确率比 DeepSeek 辅助高 23.1 个百分点（ P = 0.040 P=0.040 ），相对于仅人工评估和 DeepSeek 辅助评估，过度分类分别减少了 9.2 和 11.1 个百分点（两者 P = 0.034 P=0.034 ）；其余方向性差异均无统计学意义。

paragraphs.en: In molecular oncology decision-making (Fig. 4 d), model-standardized free-response accuracy increased by 38.3 percentage points relative to DeepSeek assistance ( P = 0.001 P=0.001 ) and by 22.2 points relative to human-only assessment ( P = 0.033 P=0.033 ). Accuracy in judging the appropriateness of clinical decisions increased by 18.5 and 20.1 points relative to the human-only and DeepSeek-aided conditions, respectively (both P < 0.001 P<0.001 ); overestimation of appropriateness decreased by 15.1 ( P = 0.001 P=0.001 ) and 16.8 points ( P < 0.001 P<0.001 ), respectively. These findings suggest that the observed gains extended to several intermediate components of evidence assessment and clinical interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 在分子肿瘤学决策中（图4d），模型标准化自由回答的准确率相对于DeepSeek辅助提高了38.3个百分点（P=0.001），相对于仅由人类评估提高了22.2个百分点（P=0.033）。 判断临床决策是否恰当的准确率相对于仅由人类评估和DeepSeek辅助条件分别提高了18.5和20.1个百分点（两者均P<0.001）；对恰当性的高估分别减少了15.1个百分点（P=0.001）和16.8个百分点（P<0.001）。 这些发现表明，观察到的提升延伸至证据评估和临床解读的若干中间环节。

paragraphs.en: Confidence–correctness alignment is preserved with ClinGeX assistance.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ClinGeX 的辅助下，置信度与正确性的一致性得以保持。

paragraphs.en: In Fig. 5 a, we examined whether improved concordance came at the cost of poorer uncertainty calibration. Certainty in criterion-level variant analysis was derived from whether participants made an explicit call for every applicable ACMG/AMP evidence item; the other two scenarios used self-reported confidence ratings. Metric definitions are provided in Supplementary Sec. A.7.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 在图5a中，我们检验了更高的一致性是否以更差的不确定性校准为代价。 标准层面变异分析的确定性来源于参与者是否对每条适用的ACMG/AMP证据条目作出了明确判定；另外两个场景则使用自我报告的置信度评分。 各指标的定义见补充材料A.7.4节。

paragraphs.en: For criterion-level variant analysis, an assessment was counted as fully certain when the participant assigned an explicit call to every applicable ACMG/AMP evidence item, and as partially certain otherwise; accuracy within a group is the proportion of its assessments adjudicated concordant. Of the 45 assessments per condition, 9 were fully certain under ClinGeX assistance and 8 of these were correct (88.9%), against 21 of the remaining 36 (58.3%); the corresponding figures were 7 of 10 (70.0%) under DeepSeek assistance and 3 of 7 (42.9%) in the human-only condition. Certainty was thus most predictive of correctness under ClinGeX assistance, although the small number of fully certain assessments limits formal comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 在变异标准层面的分析中，当参与者对每一条适用的 ACMG/AMP 证据条目都给出了明确判断时，该评估被计为完全确定，否则计为部分确定；组内准确率是该组被判定为一致的评估所占的比例。 在每种条件下的 45 项评估中，在 ClinGeX 辅助下有 9 项为完全确定，其中 8 项正确（88.9%），而其余 36 项中有 21 项正确（58.3%）；在 DeepSeek 辅助下相应的数字为 10 项中的 7 项（70.0%），而在仅人工条件下为 7 项中的 3 项（42.9%）。 因此，确定性在 ClinGeX 辅助下对正确性的预测力最强，但完全确定的评估数量较少，限制了正式的比较。

paragraphs.en: For genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making, confidence–correctness alignment was assessed using point-biserial correlation, ROC–AUC and the Brier score. ClinGeX produced the highest correlation and lowest Brier score in both scenarios ((r=0.343), Brier score 0.246 for genomic interpretation in rare disease; (r=0.212), Brier score 0.161 for molecular oncology decision-making). It also produced the highest AUC in molecular oncology decision-making (0.652); its AUC in genomic interpretation in rare disease was 0.655, marginally below that of DeepSeek (0.671). Overall, the increase in concordance with ClinGeX was not accompanied by poorer confidence–correctness alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 对于罕见病基因组解读和分子肿瘤学决策而言，置信度–正确性的一致性采用点二列相关、ROC–AUC 和 Brier 分数进行评估。 ClinGeX 在两种场景下均产生了最高的相关性和最低的 Brier 分数（罕见病基因组解读：r=0.343，Brier 分数 0.246；分子肿瘤学决策：r=0.212，Brier 分数 0.161）。 它在分子肿瘤学决策中 also 产生了最高的 AUC（0.652）；其在罕见病基因组解读中的 AUC 为 0.655，略低于 DeepSeek（0.671）。 总体而言，与 ClinGeX 一致性的提升并未伴随置信度–正确性一致性的变差。

paragraphs.en: Participants report a favorable experience and shorter completion times with ClinGeX.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者报告使用 ClinGeX 的体验良好，且完成时间更短。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by prior clinical AI evaluations [ 35 ] , we also evaluated the system from readers’ perspective. Specifically, after completing the test, participants rated their experience with DeepSeek and with ClinGeX on an anonymous five-point Likert-type items covering confidence in the answers provided, willingness to use the system again, satisfaction with the presentation of results, smoothness of operation, and reliance on system output (Fig. 5 b); ratings were summarized separately for each scenario, by the 15 participants who had completed it in the MRMC study ( n = 15 n=15 per scenario, 45 in total). More details are in Methods Sec. 4.2.6 . ClinGeX received higher mean ratings than DeepSeek on most dimensions in all three scenarios, the only exceptions being smoothness in genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making (Fig. 5 c).
paragraphs.zh: 受既往临床AI评估研究[35]的启发，我们还从阅片者视角对系统进行了评估。 具体而言，在完成测试后，参与者通过匿名的五级李克特量表项目对其使用DeepSeek和ClinGeX的体验进行评分，涵盖对所提供答案的信心、再次使用该系统的意愿、对结果呈现方式的满意度、操作流畅度以及对系统输出的依赖程度（图5b）；评分分别按各场景汇总，由在MRMC研究中完成该场景的15名参与者评分（每个场景n=15，总计45人）。 更多细节见方法部分第4.2.6节。 在所有三个场景中，ClinGeX在大多数维度上的平均评分均高于DeepSeek，仅有的例外是罕见病基因组解读和分子肿瘤学决策中的操作流畅度（图5c）。

paragraphs.en: We next compared self-reported mean time per question across the human-only, DeepSeek-aided and ClinGeX-aided conditions (Fig. 5 d). Relative to human-only, ClinGeX shortened the median time per question from 60 to 15 min for criterion-level variant analysis and from 30 to 15 min for genomic interpretation in rare disease; both differences were statistically significant ( P = 0.003 P=0.003 for both). For molecular oncology decision-making, the median time decreased from 15 to 11 min, but the difference did not reach statistical significance ( P = 0.078 P=0.078 ). This smaller effect likely reflects the shorter human-only baseline in this task, together with the fact that participant-estimated times included system response latency.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们比较了仅人类、DeepSeek 辅助和 ClinGeX 辅助三种条件下每个问题自报告的平均用时（图 5 d）。 相较于仅人类条件，ClinGeX 将标准层面变异分析的中位每题用时从 60 分钟缩短至 15 分钟，将罕见病的基因组解读中位每题用时从 30 分钟缩短至 15 分钟；两个差异均具有统计学显著性（两者的 P = 0.003）。 在分子肿瘤学决策方面，中位用时从 15 分钟降至 11 分钟，但差异未达到统计学显著性（P = 0.078）。 这一较小的效应可能反映了该任务中仅人类条件的基线用时本就较短，同时也与参与者估计的用时包含了系统响应延迟这一事实有关。

paragraphs.en: As an exploratory analysis of spontaneous continued use, we recorded new conversations initiated in the two weeks following test completion, without any instruction or inducement for the 45 participants to continue using ClinGeX. Twenty-nine participants initiated at least one further conversation beyond the three study-related sessions, generating 239 new conversations in total, with a mean of 8.2 additional conversations per continuing user (Fig. 5 e). These observations provide preliminary evidence of the system’s acceptability and voluntary reuse beyond the controlled study setting.

paragraphs.en: Controlled evaluations establish performance on standardized cases, but do not capture usability across heterogeneous, self-directed clinical-genomics tasks. We therefore conducted an exploratory, prospective task-based assessment in which experienced professionals submitted self-selected gene- and variant-interpretation tasks over a prespecified one-month period. “Prospective” refers to the forward collection of these evaluation tasks and participant feedback. This was a non-interventional, research-only evaluation, and ClinGeX outputs were not permitted to influence clinical reports, patient management or any other clinical decision.
paragraphs.zh: 受控评估确立了在标准化案例上的表现，但无法捕捉在异质性、自主导向的临床基因组学任务中的可用性。 因此，我们开展了一项探索性、前瞻性的基于任务的评估，在预先设定的一个月期间内，由经验丰富的专业人士提交自选的基因解读和变异解读任务。「前瞻性」指的是对这些评估任务及参与者反馈的前向收集。 这是一项非干预性、仅用于研究的评估，且不允许 ClinGeX 的输出影响临床报告、患者管理或任何其他临床决策。

paragraphs.en: Eleven senior clinical genomic professionals from five medical centres used ClinGeX in routine practice during a one-month period. The analysis here focused on clinicians’ episode-level feedback. An analysis episode was defined as one complete clinical-genomics objective—for example, interpreting a patient’s genomic sequencing findings or determining whether newly published evidence supported a specific variant- or gene–disease conclusion. An episode could comprise multiple dialogue turns, but its scope and analytical workflow were otherwise unrestricted. After completing an episode, the expert selected the corresponding conversation history and submitted one structured feedback record evaluating ClinGeX’s contribution to the episode as a whole, rather than to an individual prompt or turn. Thus, one feedback submission represented one completed episode; 96 submissions were collected. These records were then used to examine when and how ClinGeX helped in routine practice. For each episode, experts rated its difficulty (simple, moderate or difficult), indicated whether they adopted ClinGeX’s conclusion (fully, partially or not) and, where applicable, how many recommended evidence criteria they adopted, reported the time saved, and rated the help provided in information standardization, numerical analysis, literature analysis, and analytical or procedural guidance from little or no help to very helpful (Fig. 6 a). Full definitions of these measures are in Methods Sec. 4.3 .

paragraphs.en: Experts frequently rate ClinGeX conclusions as adoptable and report time savings.
paragraphs.zh: 专家们经常将 ClinGeX 的结论评为可采用，并报告了时间上的节省。

paragraphs.en: We analysed the reported contribution of ClinGeX at two direct, episode-level endpoints: the extent to which its conclusion was adopted in the clinician’s final assessment and whether its use accelerated completion of the analysis. Across the 96 feedback records, experts rated the conclusion as fully adoptable in 70 episodes (72.9%), partially adopting it in 21 episodes (21.9%), and not adopting it in 5 episodes (5.2%) (Fig. 6 b). They reported saving more than 15 min in 40 episodes (41.7%) and 5–15 min in another 50 episodes (52.1%); only 6 tasks (6.3%) took the same amount of time or longer. Full adoption was reported for 4/5 (80.0%) simple, 51/69 (73.9%) moderate and 15/22 (68.2%) difficult episodes. The corresponding proportions for which more than 15 min was saved were 0/5, 23/69 (33.3%) and 17/22 (77.3%), respectively, showing that the reported time benefit was concentrated in more difficult analyses while most final conclusions were fully adopted.

paragraphs.en: Experts adopt most of the evidence items recommended by ClinGeX.

paragraphs.en: As a more direct measure of assistance in routine variant interpretation, we identified 37 of the 96 feedback records that concerned variant-interpretation episodes for which ClinGeX recommended discrete ACMG/AMP evidence codes and the senior expert recorded how many were ultimately adopted. For each episode, we calculated the ratio of adopted to recommended codes, capped at 1. The mean adoption ratio was 0.83 for simple episodes ( n = 2 n=2 ), 0.87 for moderate episodes ( n = 30 n=30 ), and 0.80 for difficult episodes ( n = 5 n=5 ) (Fig. 6 c). Although the small numbers of simple and difficult episodes preclude comparisons between difficulty levels, these results show that experts retained a large proportion of the ACMG/AMP evidence codes proposed by ClinGeX in their final variant interpretations.

paragraphs.en: ClinGeX helps experts across multiple dimensions in analysis workflow.
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 在分析工作流中从多个维度为专家提供帮助。

paragraphs.en: Because ClinGeX was designed around five recurring operations in clinical genomics—guideline following, entity mapping, data-source lookup, numerical calculation and model-based prediction—we next examined the specific aspects of analysis in which clinicians found the system helpful. Experts separately rated its contribution to information standardization, numerical analysis, literature analysis, and analytical or procedural guidance. These four clinician-facing dimensions captured overlapping manifestations of the five skill categories: information standardization primarily reflected entity mapping and structured data retrieval; numerical analysis reflected numerical calculation and model-based prediction; literature analysis reflected data-source lookup; and analytical or procedural guidance reflected guideline following and cross-skill orchestration. Across the 96 episodes, mean helpfulness scores on a 0–2 scale were similar across the four dimensions, at 1.29, 1.35, 1.33 and 1.34, respectively (Fig. 6 d). Some or substantial help was reported for 90 episodes (93.8%) in information standardization, 91 (94.8%) in numerical analysis, 89 (92.7%) in literature analysis, and 92 (95.8%) in analytical or procedural guidance. Thus, clinicians reported that ClinGeX supported multiple components of genomic interpretation rather than a single analytical function.

paragraphs.en: Case studies illustrate how ClinGeX contributes to clinical genomics analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 案例研究展示了 ClinGeX 如何为临床基因组学分析做出贡献。

paragraphs.en: Two cases from the prospective deployment illustrate how ClinGeX helped clinicians address ambiguities with consequences for evidence use and clinical interpretation (Fig. 7 ). In an assessment of LRP6 c.1831C > > T (p.Arg611Cys), reported as moderately difficult by the submitting clinician, a ClinVar submission cited a family carrying p.Tyr418His as evidence for the assessed variant. ClinGeX identified this mismatch, helping the clinician avoid attributing that family’s evidence to p.Arg611Cys. The clinician reported full adoption of the conclusion, adoption of four of five recommended evidence criteria, and 5–15 min saved, and explicitly noted that the analysis helped avoid incorrect use of family evidence. In a second case, reported as difficult by the submitting clinician, TP53 c.391A > > T (p.Asn131Tyr) was detected at a variant allele fraction of 8–18% in blood from an old man with metastatic prostate cancer. The key question was whether this finding supported a hereditary cancer-risk interpretation. ClinGeX distinguished possible origins, including clonal haematopoiesis, tumour-derived DNA and constitutional mosaicism, separated germline and somatic interpretation frameworks, and proposed confirmation of sample type and additional tissue testing before assigning hereditary risk. The clinician reported full adoption of the conclusion and more than 15 min saved, highlighting the separate germline and somatic scenarios as particularly helpful.

paragraphs.en: Genomic analysis increasingly informs multiple stages of clinical care, from understanding disease mechanisms and establishing molecular diagnoses to guiding targeted interventions and population-level screening. Its broader adoption, however, is constrained by the specialized expertise required, uneven access to specialist support across centres and the difficulty of translating rapidly evolving knowledge into clinical practice. Contemporary artificial intelligence, particularly large language model (LLM)-based agentic systems, has shown promise in supporting clinical decision-making across several medical settings. Realizing this potential in clinical genomics requires systems that can reliably integrate fragmented and continuously evolving guidelines, massive databases and computational tools. Yet most evaluations remain benchmark- or simulation-based, leaving limited evidence of their effects on clinician performance and usability in workflow-relevant settings.
paragraphs.zh: 基因组分析正日益为临床护理的多个阶段提供信息，从理解疾病机制、建立分子诊断，到指导靶向干预和人群层面筛查。 然而，其更广泛的采用受到以下因素的制约：所需的专门知识、各中心获得专科支持的机会不均，以及将快速演进的知识转化为临床实践的困难。 当代人工智能，尤其是基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统，已在多个医疗场景中显示出支持临床决策的前景。 要在临床基因组学中实现这一潜力，需要能够可靠地整合碎片化且持续演进的指南、海量数据库和计算工具的系统。 然而，大多数评估仍基于基准测试或仿真，关于其在与工作流相关的场景中对临床医生表现和可用性影响的证据仍然有限。

paragraphs.en: The central contribution of this work is ClinGeX, a skill-centred agent that adapts general-purpose LLMs into clinically grounded assistants for genomic analysis . Its technical value lies in three respects. First , systematic resource collection and expert curation help reduce the omissions and selection biases associated with ad hoc resource enumeration, and may offer a template for analogous skill discovery in other clinical domains. Second , semi-automated skill construction and graph-based organization allow the skill library to expand without sacrificing efficient task-specific retrieval. Third , progressive disclosure restricts the active context to what each analytical step requires, helping constrain hallucination. The value of these design choices is supported by the automated benchmark, in which the resulting system outperformed both alternative enhancement strategies and SOTA general-purpose and biomedical agents.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的核心贡献是 ClinGeX，一个以技能为中心的智能体，它将通用大语言模型改造为扎根于临床的基因组分析助手。 其技术价值体现在三个方面。 第一，系统性的资源收集与专家整理有助于减少临时性资源罗列所带来的遗漏与选择偏差，并可为其他临床领域类似的技能发现提供模板。 第二，半自动化的技能构建与基于图的组织方式使技能库能够扩展，同时不牺牲面向任务的高效检索。 第三，渐进式披露将活跃上下文限制在每个分析步骤所需的内容范围内，有助于抑制幻觉。 自动化基准测试的结果支持了这些设计选择的价值，在测试中，所构建的系统在性能上超越了其他增强策略以及最先进的通用型和生物医学智能体。

paragraphs.en: Across the automated benchmarks, human–AI collaboration study, and prospective deployment, we demonstrate the potential practical value of ClinGeX in five complementary aspects. First , it constrains the hallucination that current LLM-based systems cannot reliably avoid, grounding conclusions in executed skills and the evidence they return; the risk this addresses is visible in the DeepSeek-aided arm, where concordance fell below that of unassisted clinicians in two of the three scenarios (15.6% versus 22.2%; 20.0% versus 31.1%). Second , it improves the quality of gene-related clinical analysis and decision-making by junior and middle-grade clinicians, raising case-level concordance with expert consensus from 22.2%, 28.9% and 31.1% to 51.1%, 57.8% and 64.4% across the three scenarios—a meaningful step towards democratizing access to expert-level interpretation. Third , it lowers interpretive burden, shortening the median time per case from 60 to 15 min for criterion-level variant analysis and from 30 to 15 min for genomic interpretation in rare disease, while presenting the complete interpretive path so that clinicians can inspect it and decide whether to adopt or override the system’s conclusion. Fourth , it showed broad workflow-level utility for experienced clinical-genomics professionals during self-directed routine use, as reflected by reported benefits spanning information retrieval and standardization, numerical and literature analysis, and procedural guidance. Fifth , the system can be deployed locally and adapts to a range of open- and closed-source backbone models, which accommodates the differing infrastructural constraints and access policies of individual medical centres.
paragraphs.zh: 通过自动化基准测试、人机协作研究和前瞻性部署，我们从五个互补方面证明了 ClinGeX 的实际应用价值。 首先，它约束了当前基于大语言模型的系统无法可靠避免的幻觉，将结论锚定在已执行的智能体技能及其返回的证据上；这一风险在 DeepSeek 辅助组中清晰可见，其一致性在三个场景中的两个低于无辅助的临床医生（15.6% 对 22.2%；20.0% 对 31.1%）。 其次，它提升了初中级临床医生基因相关临床分析与决策的质量，将三个场景中与专家共识的病例级一致性分别从 22.2%、28.9% 和 31.1% 提高到 51.1%、57.8% 和 64.4%——这是向普及专家级解读可及性迈出的有意义一步。 第三，它降低了解读负担，将标准层面变异分析的中位单例时间从 60 分钟缩短至 15 分钟，罕见病基因组解读从 30 分钟缩短至 15 分钟，同时呈现完整的解读路径，使临床医生能够查看并决定采纳或推翻系统的结论。 第四，在经验丰富的临床基因组学专业人员自主日常使用中，它展现出广泛的工作流层面实用性，其所报告的收益涵盖信息检索与标准化、数值与文献分析以及流程指引。 第五，该系统可本地部署，并能适配多种开源与闭源骨干模型，从而兼顾各个医疗机构不同的基础设施条件与访问策略。

paragraphs.en: First of all, although ClinGeX targets clinical genomic analysis broadly, the MRMC study covered only three scenarios—criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making—selected based on the participating centres’ specialties and routine caseloads. Although the skill library was not tuned to these scenarios, their evaluation does not establish generalizability to other areas of clinical genomic interpretation, such as polygenic risk assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，尽管 ClinGeX 面向广义的临床基因组分析，但 MRMC 研究仅涵盖了三种场景——标准层面的变异分析、罕见病的基因组解读以及分子肿瘤学决策——这些场景是根据参与中心的专业方向和日常病例量选定的。 尽管技能库并未针对这些场景进行调优，但其评估并不能确立其对临床基因组解读其他领域（如多基因风险评估）的普适性。

sents.zh: 首先，尽管 ClinGeX 面向广义的临床基因组分析，但 MRMC 研究仅涵盖了三种场景——标准层面的变异分析、罕见病的基因组解读以及分子肿瘤学决策——这些场景是根据参与中心的专业方向和日常病例量选定的。

sents.en: Although the skill library was not tuned to these scenarios, their evaluation does not establish generalizability to other areas of clinical genomic interpretation, such as polygenic risk assessment.
sents.zh: 尽管技能库并未针对这些场景进行调优，但其评估并不能确立其对临床基因组解读其他领域（如多基因风险评估）的普适性。

paragraphs.en: Secondly, the MRMC study was powered to detect the main effect of assistance; with 45 readers and 135 cases, several secondary comparisons showed consistent directions but did not all reach statistical significance. The primary endpoint is a proxy: concordance with expert consensus reflects interpretive quality rather than patient outcomes. Although fit for the present aim of assessing interpretive performance, establishing that improved interpretation translates into changes in clinical management and supports broader clinical use will require a prospective randomized trial with prespecified clinical endpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，本MRMC研究的设计功效是为了检验辅助的主要效应；在45名读者和135个病例的规模下，若干次要比较显示出一致的方向，但并非全部达到统计学显著性。 主要终点是一个替代指标：与专家共识的一致性反映的是判读质量，而非患者结局。 虽然这适合于评估判读性能这一当前目标，但要证明判读水平的提升能够转化为临床管理上的改变并支持更广泛的临床应用，仍需开展一项预设临床终点的前瞻性随机试验。

sents.en: Secondly, the MRMC study was powered to detect the main effect of assistance; with 45 readers and 135 cases, several secondary comparisons showed consistent directions but did not all reach statistical significance.
sents.zh: 其次，本MRMC研究的设计功效是为了检验辅助的主要效应；在45名读者和135个病例的规模下，若干次要比较显示出一致的方向，但并非全部达到统计学显著性。

sents.en: The primary endpoint is a proxy: concordance with expert consensus reflects interpretive quality rather than patient outcomes.
sents.zh: 主要终点是一个替代指标：与专家共识的一致性反映的是判读质量，而非患者结局。

sents.en: Although fit for the present aim of assessing interpretive performance, establishing that improved interpretation translates into changes in clinical management and supports broader clinical use will require a prospective randomized trial with prespecified clinical endpoints.
sents.zh: 虽然这适合于评估判读性能这一当前目标，但要证明判读水平的提升能够转化为临床管理上的改变并支持更广泛的临床应用，仍需开展一项预设临床终点的前瞻性随机试验。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the prospective deployment focused on workflow-level outcomes—including conclusion adoption, time savings and perceived helpfulness—rather than prespecified clinical endpoints such as diagnostic yield, changes in management or patient outcomes. It therefore provides evidence of practical utility in routine analysis, while the downstream clinical impact of ClinGeX requires evaluation in larger prospective studies.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，这项前瞻性部署关注的是工作流程层面的结局——包括结论采纳率、节省的时间以及感知的有用性——而非预先设定的临床终点，例如诊断产出、管理决策的改变或患者结局。 因此，它为ClinGeX在日常分析中的实际效用提供了证据，而其下游的临床影响则需要在更大规模的前瞻性研究中进行评估。

sents.en: Finally, the prospective deployment focused on workflow-level outcomes—including conclusion adoption, time savings and perceived helpfulness—rather than prespecified clinical endpoints such as diagnostic yield, changes in management or patient outcomes.

sents.zh: 因此，它为ClinGeX在日常分析中的实际效用提供了证据，而其下游的临床影响则需要在更大规模的前瞻性研究中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: ClinGeX adopts a skill-centred agentic architecture. An agent ‘skill’ [ 36 ] is a reusable instruction module, written in structured free text, that encapsulates a task-specific agentic workflow for a particular clinical or research task. Each skill specifies when it should be invoked and provides the procedural knowledge required to complete the task, including what information to seek, which standards and resources to consult, which tools to call, and how to carry out the analysis step by step (a detailed description on skills can be found in Supplementary Sec. A.2.1 ). By defining these capabilities at an atomic level, a broad and systematically curated skill library allows the agent to flexibly select, combine, and sequence individual skills to construct task-specific workflows, thereby supporting a wide range of clinical genomic analysis needs.
paragraphs.zh: ClinGeX 采用以技能为中心的智能体架构。 智能体「技能」[ 36 ] 是一个可复用的指令模块，以结构化自由文本编写，针对特定的临床或研究任务，封装了特定于任务的智能体工作流程。 每个技能规定了它应在何时被调用，并提供完成任务所需的过程性知识，包括要获取哪些信息、参考哪些标准和资源、调用哪些工具，以及如何逐步进行分析（有关技能的详细描述见补充材料第 A.2.1 节）。 通过在原子层面定义这些能力，一个广泛且系统化整理的技能库使智能体能够灵活地选择、组合和排列各个技能，以构建特定于任务的工作流程，从而支持广泛的临床基因组分析需求。

paragraphs.en: To build the skill library and integrate it into an LLM-based agent, we developed ClinGeX through a six-stage design framework. Stages 1–4 focused on constructing the skill library by identifying, curating, and formalizing domain knowledge and analytical resources into atomic agent skills. Stage 5 integrated these skills into the agent workflow through inference-time skill retrieval and orchestration, while Stage 6 focused on user interface and interaction design.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建技能库并将其集成到基于大语言模型的智能体中，我们通过一个六阶段设计框架开发了 ClinGeX。 阶段 1–4 致力于构建技能库，通过识别、整理和形式化领域知识与分析资源，将其转化为原子化的智能体技能。 阶段 5 通过推理时的技能检索与编排将这些技能集成到智能体工作流中，而阶段 6 则专注于用户界面与交互设计。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1. Web-scale scan of domain resources.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段。 对领域资源进行网络规模的扫描。

sents.en: Stage 1.
sents.zh: 第一阶段。

sents.en: Web-scale scan of domain resources.
sents.zh: 对领域资源进行网络规模的扫描。

paragraphs.en: To systematically build the skill library, we first conducted a web-scale scan to identify and collect a broad range of clinical-genomics resources for subsequent skill construction. Specifically, we organized the scan into five broad categories of clinical-genomic analysis operations: guideline following, entity mapping, data-source lookup, numerical calculation, and model-based prediction. Together, these categories capture common needs in genomic analysis, including applying clinical guidelines, converting heterogeneous entity identifiers, querying case- or cohort-level evidence from genomic and clinical databases, performing standardized calculations, and predicting the functional effects of genomic variants.
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统地构建技能库，我们首先进行了网络规模的扫描，以识别并收集广泛的临床基因组学资源，用于后续的技能构建。 具体而言，我们将扫描内容归纳为五大类临床基因组分析操作：指南遵循、实体映射、数据源查询、数值计算以及基于模型的预测。 这些类别共同涵盖了基因组分析中的常见需求，包括应用临床指南、转换异构的实体标识符、从基因组和临床数据库中查询病例级或队列级证据、执行标准化计算，以及预测基因组变异的功能效应。

sents.en: To systematically build the skill library, we first conducted a web-scale scan to identify and collect a broad range of clinical-genomics resources for subsequent skill construction.
sents.zh: 为了系统地构建技能库，我们首先进行了网络规模的扫描，以识别并收集广泛的临床基因组学资源，用于后续的技能构建。

sents.zh: 这些类别共同涵盖了基因组分析中的常见需求，包括应用临床指南、转换异构的实体标识符、从基因组和临床数据库中查询病例级或队列级证据、执行标准化计算，以及预测基因组变异的功能效应。

paragraphs.en: Because resources in these five categories are organized differently across the web, we did not use a shared search strategy for all categories. Instead, for each category, we first selected an existing broad-coverage collection as the primary source for automated resource extraction, and then manually added other important resources that were not captured. For example, to identify resources for data-source lookup, we extracted all 2,594 database entries from the cumulative alphabetical index of the Nucleic Acids Research Database Issue rather than searching it with a limited set of keywords. Because no single catalogue covers the full range of resources used in clinical genomics, we supplemented these entries with records from bio.tools, re3data.org and FAIRsharing.org and then merged records that referred to the same resource. The other four groups were scanned using the same general principle but with sources suited to each type of resource; the complete sources, search procedures and coverage limits are provided in Supplementary Sec. A.2.2 and all considered websites are listed in Supplementary Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 由于这五个类别中的资源在网络上以不同的方式组织，我们没有对所有类别使用统一的搜索策略。 相反，对于每个类别，我们首先选择一个现有的覆盖面广的集合作为自动化资源提取的主要来源，然后手动添加其他未被覆盖的重要资源。 例如，为了识别数据源查找的资源，我们从《核酸研究》数据库专刊的累计字母索引中提取了全部 2,594 条数据库条目，而不是使用有限的关键词集合进行搜索。 由于没有任何单一目录能覆盖临床基因组学中使用的全部资源，我们用 bio.tools、re3data.org 和 FAIRsharing.org 的记录对这些条目进行了补充，然后合并了指向同一资源的记录。 其余四个类别按照相同的一般原则进行扫描，但使用了适合各类资源类型的来源；完整的来源、搜索程序和覆盖范围限制见补充节。 A.2.2，所有考虑过的网站列于补充表 1。

paragraphs.en: This stage yielded 195 guidelines, 3,508 entity-mapping tools and services, 41,000 databases and resources for evidence lookup, 53 reproducible calculation methods, and 144 prediction models, forming the initial pool of candidate resources for agent skill construction. Notably, each candidate was represented by its associated free-text documentation; for example, tools, databases, and models were represented by their ‘README’ files, documentation pages, model cards, or related methodological descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 该阶段产出195条指南、3508个实体映射工具与服务、41000个用于证据查询的数据库与资源、53种可复现的计算方法以及144个预测模型，构成了智能体技能构建的初始候选资源池。 值得注意的是，每个候选资源均以其关联的自由文本文档来表示；例如，工具、数据库和模型通过其"README"文件、文档页面、模型卡片或相关方法论描述来表示。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2. LLM-assisted resource filtering and expert review.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2。 借助大语言模型（LLM）的资源筛选与专家评审。

sents.en: Stage 2.
sents.zh: 阶段 2。

sents.en: LLM-assisted resource filtering and expert review.
sents.zh: 借助大语言模型（LLM）的资源筛选与专家评审。

paragraphs.en: To further improve the quality of the candidate resources identified in Stage 1, we filtered them in Stage 2 based on their clinical relevance, reliability, and suitability for skill construction. We adopted an LLM–human hybrid filtering pipeline, in which an LLM first evaluated the candidate resources using category-specific criteria, followed by final review and selection by clinical experts.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步提高第一阶段所识别候选资源的质量，我们在第二阶段根据其临床相关性、可靠性和对技能构建的适用性对它们进行了筛选。 我们采用了大语言模型与人工相结合的混合筛选流程：先由大语言模型依据特定类别的标准评估候选资源，随后由临床专家进行最终审查与遴选。

sents.en: To further improve the quality of the candidate resources identified in Stage 1, we filtered them in Stage 2 based on their clinical relevance, reliability, and suitability for skill construction.
sents.zh: 为了进一步提高第一阶段所识别候选资源的质量，我们在第二阶段根据其临床相关性、可靠性和对技能构建的适用性对它们进行了筛选。

sents.en: We adopted an LLM–human hybrid filtering pipeline, in which an LLM first evaluated the candidate resources using category-specific criteria, followed by final review and selection by clinical experts.
sents.zh: 我们采用了大语言模型与人工相结合的混合筛选流程：先由大语言模型依据特定类别的标准评估候选资源，随后由临床专家进行最终审查与遴选。

paragraphs.en: Similar as Stage 1, the LLM rating pipeline was tailored to each resource category. For each category, we predefined a set of evaluation rubrics and prompted the LLM to assess each candidate against each rubric separately. For the entity mapping, data-source lookup, numerical calculation, and model-based prediction categories, the rubrics were quantitative, with the LLM assigning a numerical score to each rubric (e.g., 0–5). These rubric-level scores were then combined as a weighted sum to produce an overall score from 0 to 100. Based on this score, candidates were assigned to Tier 1 ( ≥ 75 \geq 75 ), Tier 2 (55–74), Tier 3 (35–54), or exclusion ( < 35 <35 ), with higher-tier candidates prioritized for subsequent review. In contrast, guideline-following candidates were assessed qualitatively: the LLM provided detailed comments on each predefined rubric without assigning numerical scores or tier levels. We designed this mainly because guidelines are typically high-value resources that warrant careful consideration. Providing a single numerical score or tier could lead subsequent reviewers to rely on that summary judgment. We therefore retained free-text comments, requiring experts to examine the underlying rationale and reach more considered conclusions. In general, the rubrics focused on the authority, currency, verifiability, and accessibility of guidelines; the clinical relevance, reliability, and accessibility of data and mapping resources; and the reproducibility, clinical support, and practical deployability of computational methods and predictive models. The complete rubrics, scoring instructions, and weights for each operation type are provided in Supplementary Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 与阶段1类似，大语言模型评分流程针对每个资源类别进行了定制。 对于每个类别，我们预先定义了一组评估准则，并提示大语言模型针对每条准则分别对每个候选资源进行评估。 对于实体映射、数据源查找、数值计算和基于模型的预测这几类，准则是定量化的，由大语言模型为每条准则赋予一个数值分数（例如0–5分）。 这些准则层面的分数随后通过加权和的方式合并，得出一个0到100的总分。 根据该分数，候选资源被划入第一梯队（≥75）、第二梯队（55–74）、第三梯队（35–54）或排除（<35），其中较高梯队的候选资源在后续审查中被优先考虑。 相比之下，指南类候选资源则采用定性评估：大语言模型针对每条预先定义的准则给出详细评论，而不赋予数值分数或梯队等级。 我们这样设计主要是因为指南通常属于高价值资源，值得审慎考量。 提供单一的数值分数或梯队等级可能使后续审查者依赖该概括性判断。 因此我们保留了自由文本评论，要求专家深入考察其背后的依据，从而得出更为深思熟虑的结论。 总体而言，这些准则聚焦于指南的权威性、时效性、可验证性和可获取性；数据与映射资源的临床相关性、可靠性和可获取性；以及计算方法和预测模型的可复现性、临床支持度和实际可部署性。 每种操作类型的完整准则、评分说明和权重见补充表2。

paragraphs.en: Eight clinical experts from seven institutions then reviewed the candidates for clinical utility, technical reliability, and functional redundancy, with the LLM-generated assessments provided as supporting material. Importantly, the LLM-derived tiers were used only to prioritize candidates for expert review and did not serve as strict inclusion thresholds. Final inclusion was determined by consensus among the eight clinicians, and lower-tier candidates could still be retained if they addressed important clinical needs not adequately covered by higher-ranked resources. More details are provided in Supplementary Sec. A.2.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 随后，来自七家机构的八位临床专家对候选资源进行了审查，评估其临床实用性、技术可靠性和功能冗余性，并将大语言模型生成的评估结果作为辅助材料提供。 重要的是，大语言模型得出的分层结果仅用于确定专家审查候选资源的优先级，并不作为严格的纳入阈值。 最终纳入由八位临床医生达成共识后确定，层级较低的候选资源如果能够满足高排名资源未充分覆盖的重要临床需求，仍可予以保留。 更多细节见补充材料 A.2.3 节。

sents.en: Eight clinical experts from seven institutions then reviewed the candidates for clinical utility, technical reliability, and functional redundancy, with the LLM-generated assessments provided as supporting material.
sents.zh: 随后，来自七家机构的八位临床专家对候选资源进行了审查，评估其临床实用性、技术可靠性和功能冗余性，并将大语言模型生成的评估结果作为辅助材料提供。

sents.en: Importantly, the LLM-derived tiers were used only to prioritize candidates for expert review and did not serve as strict inclusion thresholds.
sents.zh: 重要的是，大语言模型得出的分层结果仅用于确定专家审查候选资源的优先级，并不作为严格的纳入阈值。

sents.en: Final inclusion was determined by consensus among the eight clinicians, and lower-tier candidates could still be retained if they addressed important clinical needs not adequately covered by higher-ranked resources.
sents.zh: 最终纳入由八位临床医生达成共识后确定，层级较低的候选资源如果能够满足高排名资源未充分覆盖的重要临床需求，仍可予以保留。

sents.en: More details are provided in Supplementary Sec. A.2.3 .
sents.zh: 更多细节见补充材料 A.2.3 节。

paragraphs.en: After filtering, 105 candidate resource documents remained for skill construction: 27 for guideline following, 13 for entity mapping, 30 for data-source lookup, 12 for numerical calculation, and 23 for model-based prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 过滤后，共保留105份候选资源文档用于技能构建：其中27份用于指南遵循，13份用于实体映射，30份用于数据源查询，12份用于数值计算，23份用于基于模型的预测。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3. Skill curation through recursive optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 3。 通过递归优化进行技能筛选。

sents.en: Stage 3.
sents.zh: 阶段 3。

sents.en: Skill curation through recursive optimization.
sents.zh: 通过递归优化进行技能筛选。

paragraphs.en: In this stage, we translated the 105 selected resources into standardized, executable agent skills and iteratively refined them through a builder–evaluator loop inspired by recursive self-improvement [ 37 , 38 ] . We first consolidated the five resource categories described above into three functional skill classes: guide , search , and analysis . Guide skills were derived from clinical guidelines and other normative documents; search skills from resources for entity mapping and data-source lookup, including databases, search services, and their APIs; and analysis skills from numerical methods and predictive machine-learning models.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一阶段，我们将选定的105项资源转化为标准化、可执行的智能体技能，并通过受递归自我改进启发的构建者–评估者循环对其进行迭代优化[37,38]。 我们首先将上述五类资源整合为三个功能性技能类别：指南、检索和分析。 指南类技能来源于临床指南及其他规范性文件；检索类技能来源于用于实体映射和数据源查找的资源，包括数据库、检索服务及其API；分析类技能则来源于数值方法和预测性机器学习模型。

sents.en: In this stage, we translated the 105 selected resources into standardized, executable agent skills and iteratively refined them through a builder–evaluator loop inspired by recursive self-improvement [ 37 , 38 ] .
sents.zh: 在这一阶段，我们将选定的105项资源转化为标准化、可执行的智能体技能，并通过受递归自我改进启发的构建者–评估者循环对其进行迭代优化[37,38]。

sents.zh: 我们首先将上述五类资源整合为三个功能性技能类别：指南、检索和分析。

sents.en: Guide skills were derived from clinical guidelines and other normative documents; search skills from resources for entity mapping and data-source lookup, including databases, search services, and their APIs; and analysis skills from numerical methods and predictive machine-learning models.
sents.zh: 指南类技能来源于临床指南及其他规范性文件；检索类技能来源于用于实体映射和数据源查找的资源，包括数据库、检索服务及其API；分析类技能则来源于数值方法和预测性机器学习模型。

paragraphs.en: Each skill was initially compiled by a ‘builder’ agent based on DeepSeek-V4. The builder received the corresponding source materials together with a class-specific construction prompt and generated an initial skill implementation. For guide skills, it translated source documents into stepwise procedures and traceable decision rules. For search skills, it specified how to query the target resource, including accepted inputs, query procedures, and processing of returned records. For analysis skills, it implemented the required calculations or specified how predictive models should be invoked and their outputs interpreted. Across all three classes, each skill was represented by a standardized SKILL.md file defining its scope, inputs, execution workflow, outputs, and limitations, accompanied, where necessary, by executable scripts and supporting references. The complete construction prompts and skill specification are provided in Supplementary Sec. A.2.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 每项技能最初由基于 DeepSeek-V4 的「构建者」智能体编译而成。 构建者接收相应的源材料以及特定类别的构建提示词，并生成初步的技能实现。 对于指南类技能，它将源文档转化为分步骤的流程和可追溯的决策规则。 对于检索类技能，它规定了如何查询目标资源，包括可接受的输入、查询流程以及对返回记录的处理。 对于分析类技能，它实现所需的计算，或规定应如何调用预测模型以及如何解读其输出。 在所有三个类别中，每项技能都由一个标准化的 SKILL.md 文件表示，该文件定义了其范围、输入、执行流程、输出和局限性，并在必要时附带可执行脚本和支撑性参考文献。 完整的构建提示词和技能规范见补充材料第 A.2.4 节。

paragraphs.en: To verify and iteratively improve each compiled skill, we employed a separate ‘evaluator’ agent. Based on the source materials and the initial skill implementation, the evaluator automatically generated 5–20 skill-specific test cases, each specifying an input, the expected action or procedure, and the expected output or behaviour (representative examples are provided in Supplementary Table 3 ). The resulting test cases were then executed by a separate execution agent, instantiated as an LLM equipped with the corresponding skill. For each failed case, the evaluator summarized the observed failure in free text and provided the corresponding test output to the builder. The builder then revised the relevant skill instructions, interface specification, or executable code as appropriate, and the updated skill was subsequently re-evaluated using the same procedure. This builder–evaluation–revision cycle continued until all identified failures were resolved or a maximum of five revision cycles was reached, resulting in 105 agent skills. The workflow is illustrated in Extended Data Fig. 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证并迭代改进每个编译后的技能，我们采用了一个单独的「评估者」智能体。 基于源材料和技能的初始实现，评估者自动生成 5–20 个针对该技能的测试用例，每个用例指定一个输入、预期的操作或流程，以及预期的输出或行为（代表性示例见补充表 3）。 生成的测试用例随后由一个单独的执行智能体运行，该智能体被实例化为配备了相应技能的大语言模型。 对于每个失败的用例，评估者以自由文本总结观察到的失败情况，并将相应的测试输出提供给构建者。 构建者随后酌情修订相关的技能说明、接口规范或可执行代码，更新后的技能随后使用相同流程重新评估。 这一「构建—评估—修订」循环持续进行，直到所有已发现的失败均被解决或达到最多五个修订周期，最终产生了 105 个智能体技能。 该工作流程见扩展数据图 4。

paragraphs.en: Stage 4. Graph construction for scalable skill organization.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 阶段。 用于可扩展技能组织的图构建。

sents.en: Stage 4.
sents.zh: 第 4 阶段。

sents.en: Graph construction for scalable skill organization.
sents.zh: 用于可扩展技能组织的图构建。

paragraphs.en: After obtaining the final 105 skills, we organized them into a skill graph to support more efficient skill retrieval and combination. In the graph, each skill was represented as a node, and we exhaustively considered all possible pairwise relationships among the 105 skills, yielding ( 105 2 ) = 5,460 \binom{105}{2}=5,460 unordered skill pairs. Each pair was then evaluated for two types of relationships: functional relatedness and prerequisite dependence. For each skill pair, an LLM first assessed functional relatedness along five dimensions—purpose similarity, input overlap, substitutability, complementarity, and joint use—assigning each a score from 0 to 4. These scores were summed to form an undirected relatedness edge weight ranging from 0 to 20. Separately, a directed prerequisite edge was added when one skill required another to obtain or interpret its output. The resulting graph contained 28 directed prerequisite edges. Relatedness weights support the retrieval of complementary skills, whereas prerequisite edges preserve required workflow steps. New skills can be incorporated by evaluating only their relationships with existing nodes. Further details are provided in Supplementary Sec. A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在获得最终的 105 个技能后，我们将它们组织成一个技能图，以支持更高效的技能检索与组合。 在该图中，每个技能被表示为一个节点，我们穷举地考虑了 105 个技能之间所有可能的成对关系，得到 \binom{105}{2}=5,460 个无序技能对。 随后，对每个技能对评估两类关系：功能相关性和前置依赖。 对于每个技能对，一个 LLM 首先沿五个维度评估功能相关性——目的相似性、输入重叠、可替代性、互补性和联合使用——并为每个维度打 0 到 4 分。 这些分数相加，构成一个 0 到 20 的无向相关性边权重。 另外，当一个技能需要另一个技能来获取或解释其输出时，就添加一条有向前置边。 得到的图包含 28 条有向前置边。 相关性权重支持互补技能的检索，而前置边保留了必需的工作流步骤。 新技能只需通过评估其与现有节点的关系即可纳入。 更多细节见补充材料 A.3 节。

paragraphs.en: Stage 5. Context management based on progressive disclosure.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 5。 基于渐进式披露的上下文管理。

sents.en: Stage 5.
sents.zh: 阶段 5。

sents.en: Context management based on progressive disclosure.
sents.zh: 基于渐进式披露的上下文管理。

paragraphs.en: Till here, Stages 1–4 established the core of ClinGeX: a skill library organized as a skill graph. During inference, this graph is integrated into the host LLM’s context through task-specific retrieval and progressive plan–execute orchestration.
paragraphs.zh: 到此为止，阶段1–4确立了ClinGeX的核心：一个以技能图形式组织的技能库。 在推理阶段，该图通过任务特定的检索和渐进式的规划–执行编排被整合到宿主大语言模型的上下文中。

sents.en: Till here, Stages 1–4 established the core of ClinGeX: a skill library organized as a skill graph.
sents.zh: 到此为止，阶段1–4确立了ClinGeX的核心：一个以技能图形式组织的技能库。

sents.en: During inference, this graph is integrated into the host LLM’s context through task-specific retrieval and progressive plan–execute orchestration.
sents.zh: 在推理阶段，该图通过任务特定的检索和渐进式的规划–执行编排被整合到宿主大语言模型的上下文中。

paragraphs.en: Given a task query, ClinGeX first invokes an LLM-based intent-recognition agent (Extended Data Fig. 5 ). The agent decomposes the user’s request into one to three concrete analytical needs. Each need is encoded using Qwen text-embedding-v4 [ 39 ] , and cosine similarity is computed against the purpose and applicability descriptions of all 105 skills. The 30 highest-ranked skills form the seed set. For each seed, one-hop related skills with an edge weight of R ≥ 8 R\geq 8 are considered, and at most 15 additional skills are retained across all seeds. Three general literature- and web-search skills are included by default, after which prerequisite dependencies are recursively added until closure.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个任务查询，ClinGeX 首先调用一个基于 LLM 的意图识别智能体（扩展数据图 5）。 该智能体将用户的请求分解为一到三个具体的分析需求。 每个需求使用 Qwen text-embedding-v4 [39] 进行编码，并与全部 105 个技能的用途和适用范围描述计算余弦相似度。 排名最高的 30 个技能构成种子集合。 对于每个种子，考虑边权重 R ≥ 8 的一跳相关技能，并在所有种子中最多额外保留 15 个技能。 默认包含三个通用的文献检索和网络搜索技能，随后递归添加前置依赖，直至闭包。

paragraphs.en: After retrieval, ClinGeX invokes a host agent that loads concise descriptions of all selected skills, each summarizing the skill’s capabilities, usage boundaries, and routing rules, and uses them to formulate an overall workflow plan. The host agent then instantiates sub-agents for individual workflow steps, each of which loads the complete instructions of the corresponding skill into its context and executes the assigned task according to the skill-specific workflow. More details of this stage are provided in Supplementary Sec. A.3.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 检索完成后，ClinGeX 会调用一个宿主智能体，该智能体加载所有已选技能的简要描述（每条描述概括该技能的能力、使用边界和路由规则），并据此制定整体工作流计划。 随后，宿主智能体为各个工作流步骤实例化子智能体，每个子智能体将对应技能的完整指令加载到自身上下文中，并按照该技能特定的工作流执行被分配的任务。 该阶段的更多细节见补充材料 A.3.3 节。

paragraphs.en: Stage 6. Multimodal support and online deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段6。 多模态支持与在线部署。

paragraphs.en: In the final stage, we implemented ClinGeX as a multimodal online system. Uploaded files were processed in parallel according to type. PDFs were directly converted into Markdown-formatted text using MinerU [ 40 ] , whereas images, such as pedigree charts, were passed to Qwen3-VL [ 41 ] with a fixed instruction to generate descriptive summaries. The resulting texts were concatenated with the user’s query to form the input context.
paragraphs.zh: 在最后阶段，我们将 ClinGeX 实现为一个多模态在线系统。 上传的文件根据类型被并行处理。 PDF 文件使用 MinerU [ 40 ] 直接转换为 Markdown 格式的文本，而系谱图等图像则被传给 Qwen3-VL [ 41 ]，并附上固定的指令以生成描述性摘要。 由此得到的文本与用户的查询拼接在一起，构成输入上下文。

paragraphs.en: We deployed ClinGeX as a web application supporting multiple backbone models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemini, GLM, GPT, Kimi, etc.), heterogeneous file uploads, and concurrent queries. As shown in Extended Data Fig. 3 , the interface contains four components: a dialogue module for user input and file submission, an execution module that streams intermediate operations and tool results, a result module that presents the final structured analysis, and a user-management module for reviewing previous sessions and conducting follow-up analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 ClinGeX 部署为一个支持多种骨干模型（Qwen、DeepSeek、Gemini、GLM、GPT、Kimi 等）、异构文件上传以及并发查询的网页应用。 如扩展数据图 3 所示，该界面包含四个组件：用于用户输入和文件提交的对话模块、流式显示中间操作和工具结果的执行模块、展示最终结构化分析结果的结果模块，以及用于查看历史会话和进行后续分析的用户管理模块。

paragraphs.en: We conducted a randomized, three-condition human–AI collaboration study following established MRMC design principles [ 42 ] , with condition order and case-set assignment counterbalanced using a Latin-square-like allocation [ 43 ] , and administered the study through an online evaluation platform (Supplementary Sec. A.7.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项随机化、三条件的人机协作研究，遵循既定的 MRMC 设计原则 [ 42 ] ，条件顺序与病例集分配采用类似拉丁方的均衡分配方式 [ 43 ] ，并通过在线评估平台开展该研究（补充材料 Sec. A.7.1 ）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated ClinGeX in three clinical genomic analysis scenarios, selected to cover criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease, and molecular oncology decision-making, detailed as:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个临床基因组分析场景中评估了 ClinGeX，这些场景的选择旨在覆盖标准层面的变异分析、罕见病的基因组解读以及分子肿瘤学决策，具体如下：

paragraphs.en: ACMG-based variant pathogenicity classification and analysis (criterion-level variant analysis) Participants evaluated the applicability and evidence strength of each of the 28 ACMG/AMP criteria for a given variant and assigned a final pathogenicity classification. They also provided a written justification for their assessment, along with a confidence rating and the time taken to complete the task. This scenario primarily assessed participants’ ability to evaluate pathogenicity evidence according to the ACMG/AMP framework and integrate the applicable criteria into a final variant classification.
paragraphs.zh: 基于ACMG的变异致病性分类与分析（标准层面的变异分析）参与者针对给定变异评估28条ACMG/AMP标准中每一条的适用性和证据强度，并给出最终的致病性分类。 他们还需为其评估提供书面理由，同时给出信心评分以及完成该任务所花费的时间。 该场景主要评估参与者依据ACMG/AMP框架评估致病性证据，并将适用标准整合为最终变异分类的能力。

sents.en: ACMG-based variant pathogenicity classification and analysis (criterion-level variant analysis) Participants evaluated the applicability and evidence strength of each of the 28 ACMG/AMP criteria for a given variant and assigned a final pathogenicity classification.
sents.zh: 基于ACMG的变异致病性分类与分析（标准层面的变异分析）参与者针对给定变异评估28条ACMG/AMP标准中每一条的适用性和证据强度，并给出最终的致病性分类。

sents.zh: 他们还需为其评估提供书面理由，同时给出信心评分以及完成该任务所花费的时间。

paragraphs.en: Genomic interpretation in rare disease through integrated variant and phenotype assessment (genomic interpretation in rare disease). Participants evaluated whether the candidate genes and variants could explain the patient’s phenotype, integrating variant-level evidence with phenotype concordance and inheritance information. They provided an integrated case-level interpretation, together with a written justification, confidence rating, and completion time. This scenario primarily assessed participants’ ability to synthesize genetic and phenotypic evidence to determine the extent to which a candidate finding explained the patient’s disease.
paragraphs.zh: 通过整合变异与表型评估对罕见病进行基因组学解读（罕见病的基因组学解读）。 参与者评估候选基因和变异能否解释患者的表型，将变异层面的证据与表型一致性及遗传信息相结合。 他们提供了整合的病例层面解读，并附上书面理由、置信度评分和完成时间。 该场景主要评估参与者综合遗传学与表型证据、判断候选发现能在多大程度上解释患者疾病的能力。

sents.en: Genomic interpretation in rare disease through integrated variant and phenotype assessment (genomic interpretation in rare disease).
sents.zh: 通过整合变异与表型评估对罕见病进行基因组学解读（罕见病的基因组学解读）。

sents.zh: 参与者评估候选基因和变异能否解释患者的表型，将变异层面的证据与表型一致性及遗传信息相结合。

paragraphs.en: Molecular tumor analysis and action recommendation (molecular oncology decision-making). Participants reviewed the clinical and molecular information for a tumour case, proposed the most appropriate next analytical or clinical action, and evaluated the plausibility of a series of case-specific statements. They also reported their confidence and completion time. This scenario assessed the integration of molecular findings with clinical context, the identification of actionable evidence, and the distinction between supported and unsupported clinical recommendations.
paragraphs.zh: 分子肿瘤分析与行动建议（分子肿瘤学决策）。 参与者审阅一个肿瘤病例的临床与分子信息，提出最合适的下一步分析或临床行动，并评估一系列针对该病例的陈述的合理性。 他们还报告了自己的信心水平和完成时间。 该情境评估了将分子发现与临床背景相结合的能力、识别可行动证据的能力，以及区分有依据与无依据的临床建议的能力。
