paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe the evaluation data preparation procedures for the three clinical scenarios. For each scenario, we prepared 45 evaluation cases, resulting in a total of 135 cases:
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们描述三个临床场景的评估数据准备流程。 对于每个场景，我们准备了 45 个评估案例，共计 135 个案例：

paragraphs.en: Criterion-level variant analysis. Five experienced genetic analysts from Xinhua Hospital, each routinely interpreting more than 500 variants per year in clinical practice, contributed 39 patient records involving 45 clinically validated variants. After de-identification, the patient phenotypes, target variants, and supporting literature used in the original clinical interpretation were assembled into 45 evaluation cases.
paragraphs.zh: 变异位点评级层面的变异分析。 新华医院的五名经验丰富的遗传分析师，每人每年在临床实践中常规解读超过500个变异，提供了39份患者记录，涉及45个经临床验证的变异。 去标识化后，将原始临床解读中使用的患者表型、目标变异及支持性文献汇总为45个评估病例。

paragraphs.en: Genomic interpretation in rare disease. We obtained 25 de-identified patients with rare diseases from the 2023-2025 curated laboratory quality control cases. An expert panel from CUHK carefully reviewed the clinical information, validated variants, interpretation reports, and corresponding VCF files. Additional clinically reportable variants, including secondary findings and candidate variants with partial phenotypic correlation, were selected from the VCF files and combined with the validated diagnostic variants, producing 45 evaluation cases with distinct candidate-variant sets. Different cases derived from the same original case were not assigned to the same participant.
paragraphs.zh: 罕见病的基因组解读。 我们从2023-2025年经整理的实验室质量控制病例中获得了25名去标识化的罕见病患者。 来自香港中文大学的专家小组仔细审查了临床信息、经验证的变异、解读报告以及相应的VCF文件。 从VCF文件中选取了其他具有临床报告意义的变异，包括次要发现和与部分表型相关的候选变异，并与已验证的诊断变异合并，生成了45个具有不同候选变异集的评估病例。 来源于同一原始病例的不同病例不会被分配给同一名参与者。

paragraphs.en: Molecular oncology decision-making. We retrieved 323 human molecular-oncology case reports published after 2025 from PubMed, comprising 186 digestive-system and 137 thoracic-tumour reports. The reports were processed using a multi-model question-generation and quality-control procedure, with details provided in the Supplementary Sec. A.7.7 . Following expert review, 27 digestive-system and 18 thoracic-tumour cases were retained, yielding 45 evaluation cases. The selected cases were manually de-identified, and nonessential clinical details were redacted or reformulated to prevent AI systems from directly locating the corresponding source publications.
paragraphs.zh: 分子肿瘤学决策。 我们从 PubMed 检索了 2025 年之后发表的 323 份人类分子肿瘤学病例报告，其中消化系统病例报告 186 份、胸部肿瘤病例报告 137 份。 这些报告通过一个多模型问题生成与质量控制流程进行处理，具体细节见补充材料 A.7.7 节。 经专家评审后，保留了 27 例消化系统病例和 18 例胸部肿瘤病例，共得到 45 个评估病例。 所选病例均经过人工去标识化处理，并删改或重述了非必要的临床细节，以防止智能体系统直接定位到相应的原始发表文献。

paragraphs.en: We enrolled 54 clinical genomic professionals as participants, comprising 45 readers and 9 adjudicators. For each of the three clinical scenarios, 15 readers with relevant domain expertise were recruited. The criterion-level variant analysis cohort consisted of genetic analysts with 3–8 years of experience, recruited through Xinhua Hospital and including analysts from other hospitals undertaking advanced clinical training there. The interpretation working group of genomic interpretation in rare disease comprised clinical geneticists, genomic laboratory analysts, and postdoctoral fellows with 3–10 years of experience from Hong Kong, Guangzhou, and Shandong, recruited through the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Faculty of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong. For molecular oncology decision-making, 15 clinicians and resident trainees with approximately 4–10 years of clinical experience were recruited through Shanghai Chest Hospital, including 6 specializing in thoracic oncology and 9 in digestive-system oncology. A three-member expert adjudication panel was additionally recruited from each of the three centres for its corresponding clinical scenario; each panel comprised one senior clinician with over 10 years of experience and two additional members from the same department with over 5 years of experience. All participants gave informed consent for their study responses to be used for research analysis.

paragraphs.en: Within each clinical scenario, the 45 cases were distributed among 15 readers using a Latin-square-like allocation scheme. Each reader completed nine cases: three in the unassisted condition, three in the DeepSeek-assisted condition, and three in the ClinGeX-assisted condition. The cases assigned to an individual reader did not overlap across conditions. Consequently, each of the 45 cases was evaluated three times, once under each condition and by a different reader. The order of the three conditions was randomized across readers. For each assigned case, participants reviewed the case description and accompanying materials, completed the scenario-specific assessment, and submitted their final conclusion, written justification, confidence rating, and completion time through the online evaluation platform.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个临床场景内，45个病例通过类似拉丁方的分配方案分配给15名读者。 每名读者完成九个病例：三个在无辅助条件下，三个在DeepSeek辅助条件下，三个在ClinGeX辅助条件下。 分配给单个读者的病例在各条件之间不重叠。 因此，45个病例中的每一个都被评估三次，在每种条件下各评估一次，且由不同的读者进行评估。 三种条件的顺序在各读者之间进行了随机化。 对于每个分配到的病例，参与者需要阅读病例描述和相关材料，完成针对该场景的评估，并通过在线评估平台提交其最终结论、书面理由、信心评分和完成时间。

paragraphs.en: Several measures were used to reduce potential learning, order, fatigue, and information-leakage effects. No reader encountered the same case more than once, and the balanced allocation prevented individual cases from being evaluated exclusively under a particular assistance condition. Participants were required to work independently, to refrain from using any AI tools other than those explicitly permitted under their assigned condition, and to avoid any attempt to identify the source or reference answer of a task. To limit fatigue, the nine cases were completed over a two-week period, and participants were asked to distribute them as evenly as possible across this period. During the study, the expert panel corresponding to each clinical scenario answered procedural questions without providing case-specific guidance. After all assessments had been completed, participant responses were evaluated according to the predefined primary and secondary outcomes. Outcomes requiring clinical judgement were assessed by the corresponding expert panels whereas objective outcomes were calculated from the submitted responses and recorded task data using prespecified criteria (Supplementary Sec. A.7.2 , A.7.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 采用了若干措施以减少潜在的学习效应、顺序效应、疲劳效应和信息泄露效应。 没有任何阅读者会不止一次遇到同一病例，且这种均衡分配防止了个别病例仅在特定的辅助条件下被评估。 参与者被要求独立完成工作，除其被分配条件下明确允许的工具外不得使用任何 AI 工具，并避免任何试图识别任务来源或参考答案的行为。 为限制疲劳效应，九个病例在两周内完成，参与者被要求尽可能均匀地将其分布在这段时间内。 在研究期间，每个临床场景对应的专家组仅回答程序性问题，不提供针对具体病例的指导。 在所有评估完成后，根据预先设定的主要和次要结局对参与者的回答进行评价。 需要临床判断的结局由相应的专家组评估，而客观结局则依据预先设定的标准从提交的回答和记录的任务数据中计算得出（补充材料第 A.7.2、A.7.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: After completing all assigned tasks, the 45 readers completed the same anonymous post-study survey, with 15 readers for each clinical scenario. Survey responses were collected anonymously and de-identified before analysis.

Three open-response items asked participants to estimate their average time per case under the routine, DeepSeek-assisted, and ClinGeX-assisted conditions. These estimates were used for the main time comparison because readers were not required to complete cases in a single uninterrupted session; platform timestamps could therefore include pauses or unrelated clinical work and were not treated as active analysis time. paragraphs.en: Confidence after assistance: substantially less confident than when working independently; somewhat disrupted by the system; about the same as when working independently; slightly more confident; or markedly more confident.
paragraphs.zh: 协助后的信心：比独立工作时明显更不自信；受到系统一定干扰；与独立工作时大致相同；略微更自信；或明显更自信。

paragraphs.en: Willingness to use the system again in clinical work: very unwilling; somewhat unwilling; neutral; somewhat willing; or very willing.
paragraphs.zh: 在临床工作中再次使用该系统的意愿：非常不愿意；有些不愿意；中立；有些愿意；或非常愿意。

paragraphs.en: Satisfaction with the presentation of results in a clinical context: very dissatisfied; somewhat dissatisfied; neutral; somewhat satisfied; or very satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: 对临床情境中结果呈现的满意度：非常不满意；较不满意；中立；较满意；或非常满意。

paragraphs.en: Smoothness of system operation: not at all smooth; not very smooth; moderately smooth; relatively smooth; or very smooth.
paragraphs.zh: 系统运行的流畅度：完全不流畅；不太流畅；一般流畅；比较流畅；或非常流畅。

paragraphs.en: Reliance on system output when completing the tasks: almost no reliance; reliance on a small part of the output; reliance on approximately half of the output; reliance on most of the output; or complete reliance.
paragraphs.zh: 完成任务时对系统输出的依赖程度：几乎不依赖；依赖一小部分输出；依赖约一半输出；依赖大部分输出；或完全依赖。

paragraphs.en: Following the retrospective MRMC evaluation on controlled cases, we conducted an exploratory prospective task-based assessment to evaluate ClinGeX’s utility in daily clinical-genomics analysis, inspired by prior evaluations of clinical AI in real-world care [ 44 , 45 ] . Here, “prospective” denotes the forward collection of participants’ routine clinical or research-level analysis tasks that were comparable in nature to the evaluation tasks. Experienced clinical professionals evaluated ClinGeX on tasks arising from their usual genomic-analysis work and provided structured feedback after completing each task. The system outputs were used solely for research evaluation and were not permitted to inform or alter clinical reports, patient management or any other clinical decision. To capture clinicians’ real-world needs and patterns of use, we did not prescribe a fixed set of cases or tasks, nor did we include a control condition. Accordingly, this study was intended to characterize the task-level utility of our system in a workflow-relevant, non-interventional setting.
paragraphs.zh: 在完成对受控病例的回顾性 MRMC 评估之后，受先前在真实世界医疗中对临床 AI 评估的启发 [ 44 , 45 ] ，我们开展了一项探索性的前瞻性任务导向评估，以评估 ClinGeX 在日常临床基因组学分析中的实用性。 此处，「前瞻性」指的是前瞻性地收集参与者的常规临床或研究级分析任务，这些任务在性质上与评估任务相当。 经验丰富的临床专业人员在其日常基因组分析工作中产生的任务上对 ClinGeX 进行评估，并在完成每项任务后提供结构化反馈。 系统输出仅用于研究评估，不得用于指导或改变临床报告、患者管理或任何其他临床决策。 为了捕捉临床医生的真实世界需求和使用模式，我们既未规定固定的病例或任务集合，也未设置对照条件。 因此，本研究旨在在与工作流程相关、非干预性的环境中刻画本系统在任务层面的实用性。

paragraphs.en: We recruited 11 professionals engaged in clinical variant interpretation, each with more than five years of variant-interpretation experience and responsibility for preparing clinical reports for more than 500 cases per year. Six participants were from the Department of Genetics, Xinhua Hospital; two were from the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Faculty of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong; and one participant each was from the Department of Medical Genetics, Shandong Provincial Hospital, Anhui Provincial Hospital, and Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine. None had participated in the preceding MRMC study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们招募了11名从事临床变异解读的专业人员，每人均拥有超过五年的变异解读经验，并负责每年为500余例病例撰写临床报告。 六名参与者来自新华医院遗传科；两名来自香港中文大学医学院妇产科；另有一名参与者分别来自山东省立医院医学遗传科、安徽省立医院和上海交通大学医学院。 均未参与过先前的MRMC研究。

paragraphs.en: Professionals used ClinGeX during their routine work over a prespecified one-month period. They were asked to submit feedback on clinical genomic analysis episodes for which they had actually used ClinGeX, including, but not limited to, variant interpretation, evidence retrieval, literature analysis, and case-level analysis. They were explicitly instructed to report their experience objectively, irrespective of whether ClinGeX had been beneficial, neutral, or detrimental to completion of the analysis. All of them gave informed consent for their submitted feedback to be used for research analysis.

paragraphs.en: We developed a platform to collect structured feedback on participants’ routine use of ClinGeX. The platform did not request or extract patient names, identifiers, clinical records, genomic data or other patient-level information. Participants were instructed to follow data-protection policies throughout their use of ClinGeX and submission of feedback, including avoiding the disclosure of potential identifiable patient information.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一个平台，用于收集参与者关于日常使用 ClinGeX 的结构化反馈。 该平台不请求或提取患者姓名、标识符、临床记录、基因组数据或其他患者层面信息。 参与者被要求在整个 ClinGeX 使用和反馈提交过程中遵循数据保护政策，包括避免泄露潜在可识别的患者信息。

paragraphs.en: One feedback submission represented one completed real-world clinical-genomics analysis episode and assessed the contribution of ClinGeX across that episode as a whole. An episode could involve multiple rounds of interaction with ClinGeX; the selected conversation record was used only to associate the feedback with the corresponding episode and analysis process, rather than to define an individual message or dialogue turn as an independent evaluation. A post hoc comparison with platform conversation counts indicated feedback coverage of at least 86.5%, providing some reassurance against selective reporting (Supplementary Table 21 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一次反馈提交代表一次完整完成的真实世界临床基因组学分析事件，并评估 ClinGeX 在整个事件中的贡献。 一个事件可能涉及与 ClinGeX 的多轮交互；所选的对话记录仅用于将反馈与相应的事件和分析过程关联起来，而不是将单条消息或单个对话轮次定义为独立的评估。 与平台对话数量进行的事后比较表明反馈覆盖率至少为 86.5%，这在一定程度上保证了不存在选择性报告的情况（补充表 21）。

paragraphs.en: Analysis difficulty: simple, not requiring AI; moderate, for which AI could provide some assistance; or difficult, for which AI could provide substantial assistance.

paragraphs.en: Within this system-specific formulation, we retained two complementary taxonomies. The five construction action types —guideline following, entity mapping, data-source lookup, numerical calculation and model-based prediction—describe the clinical operation from which a prototype was discovered. The three deployment classes — guide , search and analysis —describe how the compiled skill is exposed at run time. The axes therefore need not coincide. For example, vep , mutalyzer3 and variant-validator were discovered as entity-mapping capabilities but are deployed under analysis because they perform executable transformations; conversely, ontology and identifier-mapping services are deployed under search . This mapping recovers the 27/13/30/12/23 construction counts reported in the main Methods while preserving the deployed 27/40/38 guide / search / analysis directory counts.
paragraphs.zh: 在该系统特定的表述中，我们保留了两种互补的分类体系。 五种构建操作类型——指南遵循、实体映射、数据源查询、数值计算和基于模型的预测——描述了发现原型的临床操作。 三种部署类别——guide（指南）、search（搜索）和 analysis（分析）——描述了编译后的技能在运行时如何被暴露。 因此，这两个维度不必重合。 例如，vep、mutalyzer3 和 variant-validator 被发现为实体映射能力，但因它们执行可执行的转换而被部署在 analysis（分析）类别下；相反，本体和标识符映射服务则被部署在 search（搜索）类别下。 这一映射恢复了主方法中报告的 27/13/30/12/23 构建计数，同时保留了已部署的 27/40/38 的 guide / search / analysis（指南/搜索/分析）目录计数。

paragraphs.en: Category boundaries followed the primary operation: representational conversion was entity mapping, evidence retrieval was data-source lookup, reproducible formulas or decision rules were numerical calculation, and learned outputs were model-based prediction. Conservative record linkage favoured residual duplication over false merging, and the predictor landscape was missense-enriched rather than complete across variant classes.
paragraphs.zh: 类别边界遵循主要操作：表征转换对应实体映射，证据检索对应数据源查找，可复现的公式或决策规则对应数值计算，学习得到的输出对应基于模型的预测。 保守的记录链接宁可保留残余的重复也不愿错误合并，且预测器的覆盖在错义变异上更为丰富，而非覆盖所有变异类别。

sents.en: Conservative record linkage favoured residual duplication over false merging, and the predictor landscape was missense-enriched rather than complete across variant classes.

paragraphs.en: LLMs were used to structure and prioritize the candidate space, not to make the final inclusion decision. Criterion scores were returned through structured schemas and combined deterministically using the weights in Supplementary Table 2 . Numerical screens used the same prespecified tiers: Tier 1, ≥ 75 \geq 75 ; Tier 2, 55–74; Tier 3, 35–54; and exclusion, < 35 <35 . paragraphs.en: Maintenance and citation or adoption could not always be established from static catalogue metadata and were flagged for live verification rather than inferred. For data-source-lookup candidates, a score of zero for domain centrality, guideline recognition or programmatic access forced a one-tier downgrade. Guideline documents, calculations and predictors were not forced into the database rubric because database accessibility is not an appropriate proxy for normative authority, mathematical reproducibility or clinical calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 维护情况以及引用或采纳情况并不总能从静态目录元数据中确定，因此这些项目被标记为需要进行实时验证，而非直接推断。 对于数据源查找候选项目而言，领域中心性、指南认可度或程序化访问任一项得分为零，都会导致降一级。 指南文件、计算工具和预测器没有被强行纳入数据库类目，因为数据库可访问性并不适合作为规范性权威、数学可复现性或临床校准的替代指标。

paragraphs.en: Eight clinical and domain experts from seven institutions reviewed the prioritized candidates: Xinhua Hospital; the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Faculty of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong; Shanghai Ninth People’s Hospital; Shanghai Sixth People’s Hospital; Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center; Shanghai Chest Hospital; and Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine. Reviewers considered clinical utility, compatibility with authoritative standards, complementarity, unmet need, legitimacy and stability of access, documentation, technical reliability and functional redundancy. They could retain a lower-tier candidate that filled an uncovered clinical operation, remove a higher-tier but redundant or non-invocable candidate, or consolidate several candidates into one prototype. This process froze 105 prototypes: 27 guideline-following, 13 entity-mapping, 30 data-source-lookup, 12 numerical-calculation and 23 model-based-prediction skills.
paragraphs.zh: 来自七家机构的八位临床及领域专家对优先排序后的候选方案进行了评审：新华医院；香港中文大学医学院妇产科；上海第九人民医院；上海第六人民医院；复旦大学附属肿瘤医院；上海市胸科医院；以及上海交通大学医学院。 评审者考虑了临床实用性、与权威标准的兼容性、互补性、未满足的需求、获取的合法性与稳定性、文档、技术可靠性及功能冗余。 他们可以保留一个填补了未覆盖临床操作的较低层级候选方案，移除一个较高层级但冗余或不可调用的候选方案，或将多个候选方案合并为一个原型。 该过程最终确定了 105 个原型：27 个遵循指南类技能、13 个实体映射类技能、30 个数据源查询类技能、12 个数值计算类技能和 23 个基于模型的预测类技能。

paragraphs.en: The scan was a frozen, structured landscape survey rather than a preregistered systematic review. Coverage differed across action types, conservative record linkage could retain residual duplicates, and most LLM triage scores were not independently repeated. These limitations constrain claims of landscape completeness but do not alter the identity or counts of the final frozen prototypes.
paragraphs.zh: 这次扫描是一项冻结的、结构化的领域概览调查，而非预先注册的系统综述。 不同行动类型的覆盖情况存在差异，保守的记录链接可能残留重复条目，且大多数大语言模型分诊评分未经独立重复验证。 这些局限性限制了对领域完整性的声明，但不会改变最终冻结原型的身份或数量。

paragraphs.en: Each operation retained after expert review was initialized as a self-contained skill by a builder agent. paragraphs.en: Depending on the resource, initialization produced procedural instructions alone or combined them with executable scripts, indexed references and static assets. A separate test agent then received the compiled SKILL.md and ran 5–20 predefined cases through the same action interface used at run time. Failed cases triggered revision of the instructions, interface, implementation or limitation statement followed by rerunning the complete suite; iteration stopped when no actionable failure remained or after five cycles.
paragraphs.zh: 根据资源类型的不同，初始化可能仅生成程序性指令，也可能将其与可执行脚本、索引引用和静态资源结合在一起。 然后由一个单独的测试智能体接收编译后的 SKILL.md，并通过与运行时相同的操作接口执行 5–20 个预定义用例。 失败的用例会触发对指令、接口、实现或限制说明的修订，随后重新运行完整的测试套件；当不再存在可操作的失败项或迭代达到五轮后，迭代即告停止。

paragraphs.en: Scope: <scope text> Use when: <use-when text> Each input was encoded with Qwen text-embedding-v4 using its default 1,024-dimensional output. Requests were made in batches of ten, and vectors were stored as a float32 matrix whose row order is fixed by embedding_index in skills.json . The deployed selector checks that the number of metadata rows equals the first dimension of the matrix before computing similarities. Because query and skill vectors must occupy the same vector space, the online query encoder is pinned to the same model; changing the embedding model requires regeneration of the entire matrix.
paragraphs.zh: 范围：<scope text> 使用时机：<use-when text> 每个输入均使用 Qwen text-embedding-v4 并采用其默认的 1024 维输出进行编码。 请求以每批十个的方式发出，向量以 float32 矩阵的形式存储，其行顺序由 skills.json 中的 embedding_index 固定。 部署的选择器在计算相似度之前，会先检查元数据行数是否等于矩阵的第一维度。 由于查询向量与技能向量必须位于同一向量空间，在线查询编码器被固定为同一模型；更换嵌入模型需要重新生成整个矩阵。

paragraphs.en: The embedding layer is used for task-to-skill seed retrieval, not as the sole definition of graph edges. This distinction is important: cosine proximity captures similarity between a requested need and the declared applicability of a skill, whereas it cannot by itself determine whether two skills substitute for one another, provide independent complementary evidence, or have a hard workflow prerequisite.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入层用于任务到技能的种子检索，而不是作为图中边的唯一定义方式。 这一区分很重要：余弦接近度刻画的是所请求的需求与某项技能所声明的适用范围之间的相似性，而它本身无法判断两个技能之间究竟是相互替代、提供相互独立的互补证据，还是存在硬性的工作流前置依赖。

paragraphs.en: The dependency label was one of none , A_requires_B , B_requires_A or mutual . A direction was assigned only when using the dependent skill without first consulting or invoking the other would make its result unobtainable, incomplete or invalid—either because the other supplies a required input or because it supplies the rule under which the output must be interpreted. Merely helpful context, common co-use or higher confidence was not sufficient. Deployment class was hidden as a scoring signal so that same-directory pairs received no automatic advantage.
paragraphs.zh: 依赖标签为以下之一：none、A_requires_B、B_requires_A 或 mutual。 只有当不先咨询或调用另一技能而直接使用该技能会导致其结果无法获得、不完整或无效时，才分配方向——或者因为对方提供必需的输入，或者因为对方提供输出必须遵循的解读规则。 仅仅有帮助的上下文、常见的共同使用或更高的置信度并不足够。 部署类别作为评分信号被隐藏，因此同目录的技能对不会获得自动优势。

sents.en: The dependency label was one of none , A_requires_B , B_requires_A or mutual .
sents.zh: 依赖标签为以下之一：none、A_requires_B、B_requires_A 或 mutual。

sents.en: A direction was assigned only when using the dependent skill without first consulting or invoking the other would make its result unobtainable, incomplete or invalid—either because the other supplies a required input or because it supplies the rule under which the output must be interpreted.
sents.zh: 只有当不先咨询或调用另一技能而直接使用该技能会导致其结果无法获得、不完整或无效时，才分配方向——或者因为对方提供必需的输入，或者因为对方提供输出必须遵循的解读规则。

sents.en: Merely helpful context, common co-use or higher confidence was not sufficient.
sents.zh: 仅仅有帮助的上下文、常见的共同使用或更高的置信度并不足够。

sents.en: Deployment class was hidden as a scoring signal so that same-directory pairs received no automatic advantage.
sents.zh: 部署类别作为评分信号被隐藏，因此同目录的技能对不会获得自动优势。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.5 with high reasoning effort performed the scoring through a strict structured-output schema. The model returned the five subscores, dependency enum and a short rationale; Python validated ranges and types and summed the subscores. Calls used 32-way concurrency, exponential retry for transient/API failures (up to five attempts) and a separate structured-output validation retry (up to three attempts). Records were streamed to an append-only resumable JSONL file. The completed artefact contained all 5,460 pairs, no failed or duplicate pair, and no mutual dependency. Mean (s.d.) R R was 5.45 (2.99), the median was 5 and the observed range was 0–16. The 28 directed dependencies comprised 19 A_requires_B and nine B_requires_A labels.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.5 以高推理强度通过严格的结构化输出模式完成了评分。 该模型返回五个子分数、依赖枚举和一段简短理由；Python 校验了取值范围与类型并对子分数求和。 调用采用 32 路并发，针对暂时性/API 故障使用指数退避重试（最多五次），并针对结构化输出校验失败使用单独的重试（最多三次）。 记录被流式写入一个仅追加、可断点续传的 JSONL 文件。 完成的成果文件包含全部 5,460 对样本，没有失败或重复的样本对，也没有相互依赖的情况。 R R 的均值（标准差）为 5.45（2.99），中位数为 5，观测范围为 0–16。 这 28 条有向依赖由 19 条 A_requires_B 标签和 9 条 B_requires_A 标签构成。

paragraphs.en: The edge list was compiled into 105 node records. Every node stores (i) requires , its outgoing hard prerequisites; (ii) required_by , incoming hard dependencies; and (iii) all other 104 skills in related , sorted by decreasing R R and then by identifier, with the five subscores and dependency label retained for audit. Seventeen nodes have at least one outgoing prerequisite and 19 have at least one incoming dependency. Relationship bands were defined as strong ( R = 15 R=15 –20), moderate ( R = 8 R=8 –14), weak ( R = 1 R=1 –7) and none ( R = 0 R=0 ); the deployed recall threshold deliberately includes both strong and moderate relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 边表被汇编成 105 条节点记录。 每个节点存储：(i) requires，即其出边的硬性先修条件；(ii) required_by，即入边的硬性依赖；以及 (iii) related 中的其余全部 104 项技能，按 R R 递减排列，再按标识符排序，并保留五个子分数和依赖标签以供审计。 17 个节点至少有一条出边先修条件，19 个节点至少有一条入边依赖。 关系分档被定义为强（R=15–20）、中（R=8–14）、弱（R=1–7）和无（R=0）；部署的召回阈值有意同时包含强和中两档关系。

paragraphs.en: Selection is recomputed once for every user message, including follow-up messages, rather than once for an entire session or once per internal tool call. The selector receives the current message plus at most the previous two question–answer pairs; each prior answer is truncated to 800 characters for this purpose. A fixed DeepSeek-V4-Flash decomposition step with thinking disabled returns strict JSON containing one to three short, non-overlapping English need statements. Each need must be expressed in the same objective register as a skill’s Scope/Use-when description and may represent phenotype normalization, a distinct variant type, gene–disease mechanism, or a requested classification task.
paragraphs.zh: 每次用户消息（包括后续消息）都会重新计算一次选择，而不是在整个会话中只计算一次，也不是每次内部工具调用计算一次。 选择器接收当前消息以及最多前两轮问答对；为此，每个先前的回答会被截断至 800 个字符。 一个固定的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 分解步骤（关闭思考功能）会返回严格的 JSON，其中包含一到三条简短且互不重叠的英文需求陈述。 每条需求必须以与技能的 Scope/Use-when 描述相同的客观语域来表达，并且可以表示表型归一化、一种不同的变异类型、基因-疾病机制，或某个请求的分类任务。

paragraphs.en: The maximum, rather than a mean across needs, allows a specialized skill to be retained when it matches one facet of a multi-part request. The top n = 30 n=30 skills by s i s_{i} form the seed set; no absolute cosine cutoff is applied in the deployed selector.
paragraphs.zh: 采用最大值而不是跨需求取均值，使得当某项技能匹配多部分请求中的某一面时，该技能仍能被保留。 按 s_i 排序的前 n=30 项技能构成种子集；在已部署的选择器中不应用绝对余弦阈值。

paragraphs.en: For each seed, all one-hop related edges with R ≥ x = 8 R\geq x=8 are added to a shared candidate pool. If a candidate is linked to more than one seed, only its largest edge score and the corresponding seed are retained. Candidates are ordered by decreasing edge score with identifier as the deterministic tie-breaker, and at most m = 15 m=15 are added. The expansion is intentionally one hop: newly expanded nodes do not themselves generate further similarity candidates. Independently, pubmed-search , pmc-search and tavily-search are always included because literature and official-web discovery are broadly useful; these forced skills do not act as expansion seeds. Finally, the outgoing requires list of every recalled node is traversed repeatedly until a fixed point is reached. Hard prerequisites are therefore included regardless of cosine rank, relationship threshold or the 15-skill expansion cap.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个种子，所有满足 R≥x=8 的一跳相关边都会被加入一个共享的候选池。 如果某个候选与多个种子相关联，则仅保留其最大的边分数及对应的种子。 候选按边分数降序排列，并以标识符作为确定性的平局决胜依据，最多加入 m=15 个候选。 扩展被有意限制为一跳：新扩展的节点本身不会再生成进一步的相似度候选。 另外，pubmed-search、pmc-search 和 tavily-search 始终被包含在内，因为文献检索和官方网页发现具有广泛的用途；这些强制技能不作为扩展种子。 最后，会反复遍历每个被召回节点的出边 requires 列表，直到达到不动点为止。 因此，无论余弦排名、关系阈值或 15 个技能的扩展上限如何，硬性前置条件都会被包含在内。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark used expert-curated records with discrete reference classifications and reconstructable public evidence. Eligible records were released or substantively updated after October 2025. For each case, the source identifier and version date, clinical input, supporting literature, reference answer, and scoring annotations were frozen before system evaluation. As the training-data cutoff dates of all evaluated models preceded October 2025, this temporal restriction ensured that the case-specific curation records and final reference classifications were held out from model training.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准采用了由专家精选的记录，这些记录具有离散的参考分类和可重建的公开证据。 符合条件的记录为 2025 年 10 月之后发布或实质性更新的记录。 对于每个案例，来源标识符与版本日期、临床输入、支持文献、参考答案以及评分注释均在系统评估之前予以冻结。 由于所有被评估模型的训练数据截止日期均早于 2025 年 10 月，这一时间限制确保了案例相关的精选记录和最终参考分类被排除在模型训练之外。

paragraphs.en: Supporting PMIDs were deduplicated within each source record and resolved to the local literature collection through PMID and DOI mappings. Available articles were converted to normalized plain text or Markdown while retaining headings and paragraph boundaries. Inclusion was assessed at the case level: the processed collection had to contain the public literature needed to reconstruct the reference answer. The same processed texts were supplied to every system, whereas source classifications, interpretation summaries, evidence scores and other ground-truth fields were stored separately and withheld.
paragraphs.zh: 支持性 PMID 在每个源记录内进行了去重，并通过 PMID 和 DOI 映射解析到本地文献集中。 可获取的文章被转换为规范化的纯文本或 Markdown，同时保留标题与段落边界。 纳入在案例层面进行评估：处理后的文献集必须包含重建参考答案所需的公开文献。 相同的处理后文本提供给每个系统，而来源分类、解读摘要、证据评分等基准真值字段则单独存储并予以保留。

paragraphs.en: For SNV interpretation, a public-evidence audit reduced 2,185 ClinGen expert-panel records to 1,683; requiring complete literature coverage yielded 300 eligible cases. Stratified sampling produced 79 cases (17 Pathogenic, 17 Likely Pathogenic, 17 Uncertain Significance, 12 Likely Benign and 16 Benign). The hidden reference retained the expert-panel classification, interpretation and criterion-level evidence annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 在SNV解读方面，公开证据审计将2,185条ClinGen专家组记录缩减至1,683条；要求完整的文献覆盖后得到300个合格病例。 分层抽样产生79个病例（17个致病性、17个可能致病性、17个意义不确定、12个可能良性和16个良性）。 隐藏参考保留了专家组的分类、解读以及标准层面的证据注释。

paragraphs.en: For gene–disease validity, up to 15 eligible ClinGen records were sampled per final class (fixed seed 42), with all records retained from smaller classes. The 66 cases comprised 15 Definitive, 10 Strong, 15 Moderate, 15 Limited, 2 No Known Disease Relationship, 6 Disputed and 3 Refuted relationships. Counted genetic and experimental points were summed from the structured ClinGen evidence tables, rounded to four decimal places and retained only as hidden reference annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基因-疾病有效性，从每个最终类别中最多抽样15条符合条件的ClinGen记录（固定随机种子42），较小类别的记录则全部保留。 这66个病例包括15条确定性、10条强、15条中等、15条有限、2条无已知疾病关系、6条有争议和3条被驳回的关系。 计入的遗传和实验证据分数由结构化的ClinGen证据表汇总而来，四舍五入保留四位小数，仅作为隐藏的参考注释保留。

sents.en: The 66 cases comprised 15 Definitive, 10 Strong, 15 Moderate, 15 Limited, 2 No Known Disease Relationship, 6 Disputed and 3 Refuted relationships.
sents.zh: 这66个病例包括15条确定性、10条强、15条中等、15条有限、2条无已知疾病关系、6条有争议和3条被驳回的关系。

sents.en: Counted genetic and experimental points were summed from the structured ClinGen evidence tables, rounded to four decimal places and retained only as hidden reference annotations.
sents.zh: 计入的遗传和实验证据分数由结构化的ClinGen证据表汇总而来，四舍五入保留四位小数，仅作为隐藏的参考注释保留。

paragraphs.en: Clinical actionability retained the native source ontologies. The 46 CIViC cases comprised 20 Diagnostic, 12 Predictive, 10 Oncogenic, 3 Predisposing and 1 Prognostic assertions (33 with an applicable AMP category); the 12 OncoKB cases comprised four LEVEL_1 , two LEVEL_2 , four LEVEL_3A , one LEVEL_4 and one LEVEL_R2 ; and the 20 PharmGKB cases comprised one Level 1A, sixteen Level 3 and three Level 4. CIViC Diagnostic assertions were downsampled with seed 42; the other subsets were selected after source-specific eligibility filtering.
paragraphs.zh: 临床可操作性保留了原生源本体。 46 个 CIViC 病例包含 20 个诊断性、12 个预测性、10 个致癌性、3 个易感性和 1 个预后性断言（其中 33 个具有适用的 AMP 类别）；12 个 OncoKB 病例包含四个 LEVEL_1、两个 LEVEL_2、四个 LEVEL_3A、一个 LEVEL_4 和一个 LEVEL_R2；20 个 PharmGKB 病例包含一个 Level 1A、十六个 Level 3 和三个 Level 4。 CIViC 诊断性断言以随机种子 42 进行下采样；其他子集在经过特定来源的资格筛选后选取。

sents.en: Clinical actionability retained the native source ontologies.
sents.zh: 临床可操作性保留了原生源本体。

sents.en: The 46 CIViC cases comprised 20 Diagnostic, 12 Predictive, 10 Oncogenic, 3 Predisposing and 1 Prognostic assertions (33 with an applicable AMP category); the 12 OncoKB cases comprised four LEVEL_1 , two LEVEL_2 , four LEVEL_3A , one LEVEL_4 and one LEVEL_R2 ; and the 20 PharmGKB cases comprised one Level 1A, sixteen Level 3 and three Level 4.
sents.zh: 46 个 CIViC 病例包含 20 个诊断性、12 个预测性、10 个致癌性、3 个易感性和 1 个预后性断言（其中 33 个具有适用的 AMP 类别）；12 个 OncoKB 病例包含四个 LEVEL_1、两个 LEVEL_2、四个 LEVEL_3A、一个 LEVEL_4 和一个 LEVEL_R2；20 个 PharmGKB 病例包含一个 Level 1A、十六个 Level 3 和三个 Level 4。

sents.en: CIViC Diagnostic assertions were downsampled with seed 42; the other subsets were selected after source-specific eligibility filtering.
sents.zh: CIViC 诊断性断言以随机种子 42 进行下采样；其他子集在经过特定来源的资格筛选后选取。

paragraphs.en: Reference answers were inherited from versioned source records and were not model-generated. Three physicians with more than five years of relevant experience reviewed all 223 cases for entity–record correspondence, reference-label and annotation accuracy, literature coverage, ground-truth leakage, anonymization and agreement between the task and scoring schema. Ambiguities were resolved before freezing, and system outputs did not alter the references. Only spelling, capitalization, whitespace and unambiguous aliases were normalized across databases.
paragraphs.zh: 参考答案继承自带版本管理的源记录，并非由模型生成。 三位具有五年以上相关经验的医师审查了全部223个病例，核查实体与记录的对应关系、参考标签与标注的准确性、文献覆盖情况、真实答案泄露、匿名化处理以及任务与评分模式之间的一致性。 所有歧义在冻结前均已解决，系统输出不会改动参考答案。 跨数据库仅对拼写、大小写、空白字符和无歧义的别名进行了归一化处理。

sents.en: Reference answers were inherited from versioned source records and were not model-generated.
sents.zh: 参考答案继承自带版本管理的源记录，并非由模型生成。

sents.en: Three physicians with more than five years of relevant experience reviewed all 223 cases for entity–record correspondence, reference-label and annotation accuracy, literature coverage, ground-truth leakage, anonymization and agreement between the task and scoring schema.
sents.zh: 三位具有五年以上相关经验的医师审查了全部223个病例，核查实体与记录的对应关系、参考标签与标注的准确性、文献覆盖情况、真实答案泄露、匿名化处理以及任务与评分模式之间的一致性。

sents.en: Ambiguities were resolved before freezing, and system outputs did not alter the references.
sents.zh: 所有歧义在冻结前均已解决，系统输出不会改动参考答案。

sents.en: Only spelling, capitalization, whitespace and unambiguous aliases were normalized across databases.
sents.zh: 跨数据库仅对拼写、大小写、空白字符和无歧义的别名进行了归一化处理。

paragraphs.en: All systems received the same case-level clinical entities, task instructions and processed literature, with no cross-case history. Ground-truth fields were withheld; direct access to the five source databases was prohibited. Individual papers were limited to 80,000 characters and combined literature to 200,000 characters. System configurations are given in Supplementary Table 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有系统接收到的病例级临床实体、任务指令和处理后的文献均相同，且无跨病例历史记录。 真实标准字段被隐藏，且禁止直接访问五个源数据库。 单篇论文限制在 80,000 字符以内，合并文献限制在 200,000 字符以内。 各系统的配置见补充表 7。

sents.en: All systems received the same case-level clinical entities, task instructions and processed literature, with no cross-case history.
sents.zh: 所有系统接收到的病例级临床实体、任务指令和处理后的文献均相同，且无跨病例历史记录。

sents.en: Ground-truth fields were withheld; direct access to the five source databases was prohibited.
sents.zh: 真实标准字段被隐藏，且禁止直接访问五个源数据库。

sents.en: Individual papers were limited to 80,000 characters and combined literature to 200,000 characters.
sents.zh: 单篇论文限制在 80,000 字符以内，合并文献限制在 200,000 字符以内。

sents.en: System configurations are given in Supplementary Table 7 .
sents.zh: 各系统的配置见补充表 7。

paragraphs.en: Because some systems provided their own search or database tools, we additionally used an LLM to audit each complete execution record for substantive case-specific information obtained from the corresponding reference resource, either directly or indirectly through an intermediary. Mere mention of a resource or use of general framework terminology was not counted. Positive records were uncommon for every system and task (Supplementary Table 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 由于部分系统提供了自带的搜索或数据库工具，我们还额外使用一个大语言模型来审计每条完整的执行记录，检查其是否包含从相应参考资源中直接或通过中介间接获得的实质性案例特定信息。 仅仅提及某个资源或使用一般性框架术语不计入在内。 对于每个系统和每项任务而言，阳性记录都不常见（补充表 6）。

sents.en: Because some systems provided their own search or database tools, we additionally used an LLM to audit each complete execution record for substantive case-specific information obtained from the corresponding reference resource, either directly or indirectly through an intermediary.
sents.zh: 由于部分系统提供了自带的搜索或数据库工具，我们还额外使用一个大语言模型来审计每条完整的执行记录，检查其是否包含从相应参考资源中直接或通过中介间接获得的实质性案例特定信息。

sents.en: Mere mention of a resource or use of general framework terminology was not counted.
sents.zh: 仅仅提及某个资源或使用一般性框架术语不计入在内。

sents.zh: 对于每个系统和每项任务而言，阳性记录都不常见（补充表 6）。

paragraphs.en: Values are the number of execution records with direct or indirect acquisition of substantive case-specific information from the corresponding reference resource divided by the number of cases in that task.
paragraphs.zh: 数值表示从对应参考资源直接或间接获取实质性案例特定信息的执行记录数量除以该任务中的案例数量所得的结果。

paragraphs.en: Archived execution records verified the backends for OpenAI DeepResearch, Biomni, TxAgent and ClinGeX. SciSpace exposed no model identifier and is therefore reported as undisclosed; the archived materials did not specify the OpenBioLLM repository revision or numerical precision.
paragraphs.zh: 已归档的执行记录验证了 OpenAI DeepResearch、Biomni、TxAgent 和 ClinGeX 的后端。 SciSpace 未暴露模型标识符，因此报告为未披露；已归档材料未指明 OpenBioLLM 的仓库版本或数值精度。

sents.en: Archived execution records verified the backends for OpenAI DeepResearch, Biomni, TxAgent and ClinGeX.
sents.zh: 已归档的执行记录验证了 OpenAI DeepResearch、Biomni、TxAgent 和 ClinGeX 的后端。

sents.en: SciSpace exposed no model identifier and is therefore reported as undisclosed; the archived materials did not specify the OpenBioLLM repository revision or numerical precision.
sents.zh: SciSpace 未暴露模型标识符，因此报告为未披露；已归档材料未指明 OpenBioLLM 的仓库版本或数值精度。

paragraphs.en: The system-specific execution controls recorded in the archived harnesses are summarized in Supplementary Table 8 . Free-text answers were subsequently converted into task-specific structured fields by a fixed extraction pipeline. Missing or unrecognized fields were retained as null values rather than repaired from the reference answer.
paragraphs.zh: 归档工具框架中记录的系统特定执行控制方式总结于补充表 8。 自由文本答案随后由固定的提取流程转换为特定任务的结构化字段。 缺失或无法识别的字段被保留为空值，而不是参照参考答案进行修复。

sents.en: The system-specific execution controls recorded in the archived harnesses are summarized in Supplementary Table 8 .
sents.zh: 归档工具框架中记录的系统特定执行控制方式总结于补充表 8。

sents.en: Free-text answers were subsequently converted into task-specific structured fields by a fixed extraction pipeline.
sents.zh: 自由文本答案随后由固定的提取流程转换为特定任务的结构化字段。

paragraphs.en: Final-classification and evidence metrics were computed from the frozen single-output records described below. The repeated-run consistency and per-case wall-clock time reported in the main figure were obtained through a separate repetition-and-timing workflow and were not derived from those single-output metric files.
paragraphs.zh: 最终分类与证据指标基于下文所述的冻结单输出记录计算得到。 主图中所报告的重复运行一致性与单病例耗时（wall-clock time）是通过单独的重复与计时流程获得的，并非由那些单输出指标文件推导而来。

sents.en: Final-classification and evidence metrics were computed from the frozen single-output records described below.
sents.zh: 最终分类与证据指标基于下文所述的冻结单输出记录计算得到。

sents.en: The repeated-run consistency and per-case wall-clock time reported in the main figure were obtained through a separate repetition-and-timing workflow and were not derived from those single-output metric files.
sents.zh: 主图中所报告的重复运行一致性与单病例耗时（wall-clock time）是通过单独的重复与计时流程获得的，并非由那些单输出指标文件推导而来。

paragraphs.en: All reported classification and evidence metrics were recomputed from the frozen structured reference data and extracted system outputs by deterministic code. The denominators differ by task and, in two cases, by endpoint; they are summarized in Supplementary Table 9 . No LLM judge determined whether a final classification matched the reference.
paragraphs.zh: 所有报告的分类与证据指标均由确定性代码基于冻结的结构化参考数据和系统提取输出重新计算。 分母因任务而异，在两种情况下还因终点而异；这些分母汇总于补充表 9。 没有使用大语言模型评判者来判断最终分类是否与参考数据匹配。

sents.en: All reported classification and evidence metrics were recomputed from the frozen structured reference data and extracted system outputs by deterministic code.
sents.zh: 所有报告的分类与证据指标均由确定性代码基于冻结的结构化参考数据和系统提取输出重新计算。

sents.en: The denominators differ by task and, in two cases, by endpoint; they are summarized in Supplementary Table 9 .

sents.zh: 没有使用大语言模型评判者来判断最终分类是否与参考数据匹配。

paragraphs.en: Final-classification concordance required an exact five-tier match. Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic and Benign/Likely Benign formed the positive and negative groups for sensitivity and specificity; VUS cases were excluded. A significant error was a direction reversal between these groups and used all 79 cases as its denominator.
paragraphs.zh: 最终分类的一致性要求五级完全匹配。 致病性/可能致病性和良性/可能良性分别构成敏感性和特异性的阳性组和阴性组；意义未明变异（VUS）病例被排除。 重大错误定义为这两组之间的方向反转，并以全部 79 例作为其分母。

sents.en: Final-classification concordance required an exact five-tier match.
sents.zh: 最终分类的一致性要求五级完全匹配。

sents.en: Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic and Benign/Likely Benign formed the positive and negative groups for sensitivity and specificity; VUS cases were excluded.
sents.zh: 致病性/可能致病性和良性/可能良性分别构成敏感性和特异性的阳性组和阴性组；意义未明变异（VUS）病例被排除。

sents.en: A significant error was a direction reversal between these groups and used all 79 cases as its denominator.
sents.zh: 重大错误定义为这两组之间的方向反转，并以全部 79 例作为其分母。

paragraphs.en: For reference criterion set E i E_{i} and recovered set E ^ i \hat{E}_{i} , micro recall was ∑ i | E i ∩ E ^ i | / ∑ i | E i | \sum_{i}|E_{i}\cap\hat{E}_{i}|/\sum_{i}|E_{i}| and macro recall was the mean case-level recall; the micro value is the weighted evidence recall reported in the main figure. A criterion counted only when asserted as met for the evaluated variant–disease pair. Strength concordance required exact strength agreement among correctly recovered criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 对于参考判据集合 E i E_{i} 和恢复判据集合 E ^ i \hat{E}_{i}，微观召回率为 ∑ i | E i ∩ E ^ i | / ∑ i | E i | \sum_{i}|E_{i}\cap\hat{E}_{i}|/\sum_{i}|E_{i}|，宏观召回率为病例层面召回率的均值；微观值即主图中报告的加权证据召回率。 只有当针对所评估的变异–疾病对被断言为满足时，该判据才计入。 强度一致性要求正确恢复的判据在强度上完全一致。

sents.en: For reference criterion set E i E_{i} and recovered set E ^ i \hat{E}_{i} , micro recall was ∑ i | E i ∩ E ^ i | / ∑ i | E i | \sum_{i}|E_{i}\cap\hat{E}_{i}|/\sum_{i}|E_{i}| and macro recall was the mean case-level recall; the micro value is the weighted evidence recall reported in the main figure.
sents.zh: 对于参考判据集合 E i E_{i} 和恢复判据集合 E ^ i \hat{E}_{i}，微观召回率为 ∑ i | E i ∩ E ^ i | / ∑ i | E i | \sum_{i}|E_{i}\cap\hat{E}_{i}|/\sum_{i}|E_{i}|，宏观召回率为病例层面召回率的均值；微观值即主图中报告的加权证据召回率。

sents.en: A criterion counted only when asserted as met for the evaluated variant–disease pair.
sents.zh: 只有当针对所评估的变异–疾病对被断言为满足时，该判据才计入。

sents.en: Strength concordance required exact strength agreement among correctly recovered criteria.
sents.zh: 强度一致性要求正确恢复的判据在强度上完全一致。

paragraphs.en: The fixed ranks were Refuted = − 2 =-2 , Disputed = − 1 =-1 , No Known Disease Relationship = 0 =0 , Limited = 1 =1 , Moderate = 2 =2 , Strong = 3 =3 and Definitive = 4 =4 . Concordance and rank differences used parsable seven-category outputs; differences of at least two levels defined primary severe over- or under-classification (three levels in supplementary analyses).
paragraphs.zh: 固定等级为：被驳斥（Refuted）= −2、有争议（Disputed）= −1、无已知疾病关系（No Known Disease Relationship）= 0、有限（Limited）= 1、中等（Moderate）= 2、强（Strong）= 3、确凿（Definitive）= 4。 一致性分析和等级差异分析使用了可解析的七类输出；差异达到两个及以上等级被定义为主要的严重高分类或低分类（补充分析中为三个等级）。

sents.en: The fixed ranks were Refuted = − 2 =-2 , Disputed = − 1 =-1 , No Known Disease Relationship = 0 =0 , Limited = 1 =1 , Moderate = 2 =2 , Strong = 3 =3 and Definitive = 4 =4 .
sents.zh: 固定等级为：被驳斥（Refuted）= −2、有争议（Disputed）= −1、无已知疾病关系（No Known Disease Relationship）= 0、有限（Limited）= 1、中等（Moderate）= 2、强（Strong）= 3、确凿（Definitive）= 4。

sents.en: Concordance and rank differences used parsable seven-category outputs; differences of at least two levels defined primary severe over- or under-classification (three levels in supplementary analyses).
sents.zh: 一致性分析和等级差异分析使用了可解析的七类输出；差异达到两个及以上等级被定义为主要的严重高分类或低分类（补充分析中为三个等级）。

paragraphs.en: Evidence “coverage” denotes reporting of a usable genetic or experimental score, not item-level recall. Reference scores were capped at 12 and 6 points, respectively. For an extracted interval [ L i , H i ] [L_{i},H_{i}] and reference g i g_{i} , error was max ⁡ ( 0 , L i − g i , g i − H i ) \max(0,L_{i}-g_{i},g_{i}-H_{i}) ; MAE was conditional on a stated score, with no imputation.
paragraphs.zh: 证据“覆盖度”指报告了可用的遗传或实验评分，而非条目级别的召回率。 参考评分分别上限设为 12 分和 6 分。 对于提取的区间 [ L i , H i ] [L_{i},H_{i}] 和参考值 g i g_{i}，误差为 max ⁡ ( 0 , L i − g i , g i − H i ) \max(0,L_{i}-g_{i},g_{i}-H_{i})；平均绝对误差（MAE）以已给出评分为条件，不做任何插补。

sents.en: Evidence “coverage” denotes reporting of a usable genetic or experimental score, not item-level recall.
sents.zh: 证据“覆盖度”指报告了可用的遗传或实验评分，而非条目级别的召回率。

sents.en: Reference scores were capped at 12 and 6 points, respectively.
sents.zh: 参考评分分别上限设为 12 分和 6 分。

sents.en: For an extracted interval [ L i , H i ] [L_{i},H_{i}] and reference g i g_{i} , error was max ⁡ ( 0 , L i − g i , g i − H i ) \max(0,L_{i}-g_{i},g_{i}-H_{i}) ; MAE was conditional on a stated score, with no imputation.
sents.zh: 对于提取的区间 [ L i , H i ] [L_{i},H_{i}] 和参考值 g i g_{i}，误差为 max ⁡ ( 0 , L i − g i , g i − H i ) \max(0,L_{i}-g_{i},g_{i}-H_{i})；平均绝对误差（MAE）以已给出评分为条件，不做任何插补。

paragraphs.en: Final-classification concordance used the 65 cases with an applicable tier: CIViC AMP category, OncoKB level or PharmGKB level. Complete-answer accuracy used all 78 cases and required, respectively, CIViC assertion type/significance/direction and applicable AMP category; OncoKB level and exact drug set; or PharmGKB level and a score within 0.5 points of reference.
paragraphs.zh: 最终分类一致性分析采用了65个具有适用分层级别的病例：CIViC AMP类别、OncoKB级别或PharmGKB级别。 完整回答准确性分析采用了全部78个病例，分别要求：CIViC断言类型/意义/方向及适用的AMP类别；OncoKB级别及确切的药物集合；或PharmGKB级别及与参考值相差0.5分以内的评分。

sents.en: Final-classification concordance used the 65 cases with an applicable tier: CIViC AMP category, OncoKB level or PharmGKB level.
sents.zh: 最终分类一致性分析采用了65个具有适用分层级别的病例：CIViC AMP类别、OncoKB级别或PharmGKB级别。

sents.en: Complete-answer accuracy used all 78 cases and required, respectively, CIViC assertion type/significance/direction and applicable AMP category; OncoKB level and exact drug set; or PharmGKB level and a score within 0.5 points of reference.
sents.zh: 完整回答准确性分析采用了全部78个病例，分别要求：CIViC断言类型/意义/方向及适用的AMP类别；OncoKB级别及确切的药物集合；或PharmGKB级别及与参考值相差0.5分以内的评分。

paragraphs.en: Severity analyses used the source-specific ranks in Supplementary Table 10 . A rank difference of at least two levels defined primary severe over- or under-classification (three levels in supplementary analyses); missing or unmappable labels remained in the fixed 65-case denominator.
paragraphs.zh: 严重程度分析使用了 Supplementary Table 10 中针对各数据来源的分级。 至少两个等级的分级差异被定义为严重的过度或不足分类（补充分析中为三个等级）；缺失或无法映射的标签仍保留在固定的65例分母中。

sents.en: Severity analyses used the source-specific ranks in Supplementary Table 10 .
sents.zh: 严重程度分析使用了 Supplementary Table 10 中针对各数据来源的分级。

sents.en: A rank difference of at least two levels defined primary severe over- or under-classification (three levels in supplementary analyses); missing or unmappable labels remained in the fixed 65-case denominator.

paragraphs.en: The placement of OncoKB resistance categories is an analysis convention rather than an official crosswalk: LEVEL_R1 was aligned with standard-care evidence at rank 5 and LEVEL_R2 with emerging clinical evidence at rank 3. This convention was fixed in the evaluator before system comparison.

Supplementary Table 9 gives all endpoint-specific denominators.

paragraphs.en: Nine clinicians rated the reports from ClinGeX, Biomni and DeepResearch for all 223 cases. Six clinicians with more than three years of genetic-analysis experience reviewed SNV or gene–disease reports; three internal-medicine physicians with more than five years of experience reviewed clinical-actionability reports.
paragraphs.zh: 九名临床医生对 ClinGeX、Biomni 和 DeepResearch 生成的全部 223 个病例的报告进行了评分。 六名具有三年以上基因分析经验的临床医生审阅了 SNV 或基因-疾病报告；三名具有五年以上经验的内科医生审阅了临床可操作性报告。

paragraphs.en: This experiment compared the complete ClinGeX architecture with an unenhanced DeepSeek-V4 baseline and five single-strategy enhancements on evidence-grounded question–answering items. DeepSeek-V4, item text and hidden-reference controls were held fixed, so conditions differed only in the enhancement or orchestration layer listed in Supplementary Table 13 . Unlike the 223-case end-to-end benchmark, this dataset isolated specific evidence-reasoning operations.
paragraphs.zh: 该实验在有证据支撑的问答题目上，将完整的 ClinGeX 架构与未增强的 DeepSeek-V4 基线以及五种单策略增强进行了比较。 DeepSeek-V4、题目文本和隐藏参考控制项均保持不变，因此各条件仅在补充表 13 所列的增强或编排层上有所不同。 与 223 个案例的端到端基准不同，该数据集隔离了特定的证据推理操作。

sents.en: This experiment compared the complete ClinGeX architecture with an unenhanced DeepSeek-V4 baseline and five single-strategy enhancements on evidence-grounded question–answering items.
sents.zh: 该实验在有证据支撑的问答题目上，将完整的 ClinGeX 架构与未增强的 DeepSeek-V4 基线以及五种单策略增强进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Supplementary Table 13 defines the seven conditions. The RAG condition exposed only the search-facing functions from the ClinGeX library; few-shot used the same three fixed demonstrations for every item; and the multi-agent condition used sequential planner, executor and reviewer roles. BioSkill ( https://github.com/GPTomics/bioSkills ) and MedSkill ( https://github.com/aipoch/medical-research-skills ) were frozen snapshots exposed through the same discovery-and-load wrapper without adding ClinGeX content or graph edges. The full ClinGeX condition retained its native skill selection, dependency expansion and progressive execution workflow. No condition received the hidden reference answer or scoring rubric.
paragraphs.zh: 补充表 13 定义了这七种条件。 RAG 条件仅暴露 ClinGeX 库中面向搜索的函数；few-shot 条件对每个条目使用相同的三个固定示范；而多智能体条件使用依次执行的规划者、执行者和审阅者角色。 BioSkill（https://github.com/GPTomics/bioSkills）和 MedSkill（https://github.com/aipoch/medical-research-skills）为冻结快照，通过相同的发现与加载封装器暴露，未添加 ClinGeX 内容或图谱边。 完整 ClinGeX 条件保留了其原生的技能选择、依赖扩展和渐进式执行工作流。 任何条件均未获得隐藏的参考答案或评分细则。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark drew from ClinVar, ClinGen, CIViC, OncoKB and ClinPGx. Eighty diversity-oriented anchors were selected deterministically: 10 each from OncoKB and CIViC and 20 each from ClinPGx, ClinVar and ClinGen. Selection favoured distinct genes and, where applicable, literature-supported pathogenic assertions or ClinGen records with both genetic and experimental evidence and non-trivial scoring or mechanistic issues.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准数据来源于ClinVar、ClinGen、CIViC、OncoKB和ClinPGx。 以确定性方式选取了80个多样性导向的锚点：OncoKB和CIViC各10个，ClinPGx、ClinVar和ClinGen各20个。 选取时优先考虑不同的基因，并在适用情况下优先考虑有文献支持的致病性断言，或同时具有遗传学和实验证据、且涉及非平凡评分或机制问题的ClinGen记录。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-V4 generated items in 240 independent anchor–tier jobs using source- and tier-specific instructions, structured records and linked full text; related records could be retrieved for clinically plausible comparisons or distractors. Retained items had to pose a meaningful clinical operation, have a literature-verifiable answer and require interpretation rather than copying. Schema validation required a source-grounded answer, numeric PMIDs with relevance labels, at least one relevant PMID, a construction rationale and an item-level rubric. The final 426 items are summarized in Supplementary Table 14 .
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek-V4 在 240 个独立的锚点—层级任务中使用针对来源和层级的指令、结构化记录以及关联的全文生成了试题；相关记录可以被检索出来，用于临床上合理的对比或干扰项。 保留的试题必须提出有意义的临床操作，具有可通过文献验证的答案，并且要求的是解读而非照抄。 模式验证要求答案有来源依据，PMID 为数字并带有相关性标签，至少有一个相关 PMID，包含构建理由以及试题层面的评分细则。 最终的 426 道试题总结于补充表 14 中。

paragraphs.en: Tiers were defined by the required evidence operation, as specified in Supplementary Table 15 . Tier 1 items used no deliberately irrelevant PMID and cited a mean of 1.19 publications. Tier 3 integrated multiple sources (mean 4.93 publications) and comprised 51 easy, 27 medium and 27 hard items according to evidence volume, conflict and irrelevant context.

paragraphs.en: Each item therefore contributed equally, regardless of rubric length or publication count. The same mean was calculated by reasoning tier and clinical-genomics domain; it measures rubric-defined factual correctness, evidence selection and weighting, completeness and final synthesis rather than exact-match accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，无论评分细则长度或发表数量如何，每个条目的贡献均相等。 同样的平均值还按推理层级和临床基因组学领域分别计算；它衡量的是评分细则所定义的事实正确性、证据选择与权重、完整性以及最终综合，而非精确匹配的准确性。

paragraphs.en: The full ClinGeX architecture achieved the highest rubric-normalised score overall and in every reasoning tier (Extended Data Fig. 1 c). Its overall score was 83.2%, compared with 72.2% for the unenhanced DeepSeek-V4 baseline and 74.0–78.4% for the five single-strategy conditions. The largest separation occurred for tier 3 synthesis tasks. ClinGeX scored 70.1% on variant-interpretation items, 56.7% on gene–disease-validity items and 84.9% on clinical-actionability items, corresponding to improvements of 15.2, 11.1 and 15.1 percentage points, respectively, over the same base model without an enhancement layer. These controlled comparisons supported selection of the complete skill-centred architecture for the main system evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 ClinGeX 架构在总体及每个推理层级上都取得了最高的量规归一化得分（扩展数据图 1c）。 其总体得分为 83.2%，而未增强的 DeepSeek-V4 基线为 72.2%，五种单一策略条件为 74.0–78.4%。 差距最大的是第 3 层级的综合任务。 ClinGeX 在变异解读类条目上得分为 70.1%，在基因—疾病有效性条目上为 56.7%，在临床可操作性条目上为 84.9%，相对于无增强层的同一基础模型分别提高了 15.2、11.1 和 15.1 个百分点。 这些对照比较支持在主系统评估中选用完整的以技能为中心的架构。

sents.en: The full ClinGeX architecture achieved the highest rubric-normalised score overall and in every reasoning tier (Extended Data Fig. 1 c).
sents.zh: 完整的 ClinGeX 架构在总体及每个推理层级上都取得了最高的量规归一化得分（扩展数据图 1c）。

sents.en: Its overall score was 83.2%, compared with 72.2% for the unenhanced DeepSeek-V4 baseline and 74.0–78.4% for the five single-strategy conditions.
sents.zh: 其总体得分为 83.2%，而未增强的 DeepSeek-V4 基线为 72.2%，五种单一策略条件为 74.0–78.4%。

sents.en: The largest separation occurred for tier 3 synthesis tasks.
sents.zh: 差距最大的是第 3 层级的综合任务。

sents.en: ClinGeX scored 70.1% on variant-interpretation items, 56.7% on gene–disease-validity items and 84.9% on clinical-actionability items, corresponding to improvements of 15.2, 11.1 and 15.1 percentage points, respectively, over the same base model without an enhancement layer.
sents.zh: ClinGeX 在变异解读类条目上得分为 70.1%，在基因—疾病有效性条目上为 56.7%，在临床可操作性条目上为 84.9%，相对于无增强层的同一基础模型分别提高了 15.2、11.1 和 15.1 个百分点。

sents.en: These controlled comparisons supported selection of the complete skill-centred architecture for the main system evaluation.
sents.zh: 这些对照比较支持在主系统评估中选用完整的以技能为中心的架构。

paragraphs.en: This experiment changed only the LLM core while holding the complete ClinGeX architecture, skills, tools, instructions and 3,662-item input set fixed. It compared the six frontier models in Supplementary Table 16 across variant interpretation ( n = 1,366 n=1{,}366 ), gene–disease validity ( n = 1,253 n=1{,}253 ) and clinical actionability ( n = 1,043 n=1{,}043 ). Candidate cores were excluded from external judging.
paragraphs.zh: 本实验仅更换了大语言模型核心，同时保持完整的 ClinGeX 架构、技能、工具、指令以及 3,662 条输入集不变。 该实验比较了补充表 16 中的六个前沿模型在变异解读（n=1,366）、基因–疾病有效性（n=1,253）和临床可操作性（n=1,043）方面的表现。 候选核心模型被排除在外部评审之外。

sents.en: This experiment changed only the LLM core while holding the complete ClinGeX architecture, skills, tools, instructions and 3,662-item input set fixed.
sents.zh: 本实验仅更换了大语言模型核心，同时保持完整的 ClinGeX 架构、技能、工具、指令以及 3,662 条输入集不变。

sents.en: It compared the six frontier models in Supplementary Table 16 across variant interpretation ( n = 1,366 n=1{,}366 ), gene–disease validity ( n = 1,253 n=1{,}253 ) and clinical actionability ( n = 1,043 n=1{,}043 ).
sents.zh: 该实验比较了补充表 16 中的六个前沿模型在变异解读（n=1,366）、基因–疾病有效性（n=1,253）和临床可操作性（n=1,043）方面的表现。

sents.en: Candidate cores were excluded from external judging.
sents.zh: 候选核心模型被排除在外部评审之外。

paragraphs.en: The six pipelines used ClinVar and ClinGen-ACMG for variant interpretation, ClinGen Gene–Disease Validity for gene–disease assessment, and CIViC, OncoKB and PharmGKB/ClinPGx for clinical actionability. Every item was joined to a processed publication at the finest PMID-linked evidence unit supported by its source schema. Multi-publication narratives were treated only as trust anchors; claims and evidence codes had to be verified in the current paper, preventing cross-paper leakage or attribution to a comparator allele, disease, drug or population.
paragraphs.zh: 六条流程管线使用 ClinVar 和 ClinGen-ACMG 进行变异解读，使用 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性（Gene–Disease Validity）进行基因-疾病评估，并使用 CIViC、OncoKB 和 PharmGKB/ClinPGx 评估临床可操作性。 每个条目都被关联到其来源模式所支持的最细粒度的、与 PMID 关联的证据单元对应的已处理文献。 涉及多篇文献的叙述仅作为可信度锚点；论断和证据代码必须在当前论文中得到验证，以防止跨论文的信息泄漏，或错误归因于对照等位基因、疾病、药物或人群。

paragraphs.en: Source-specific candidate, acceptance and final-inclusion counts are given in Supplementary Table 17 . The frozen experiment contained 3,662 items: 1,366 variant-interpretation, 1,253 gene–disease-validity and 1,043 clinical-actionability items.
paragraphs.zh: 各来源的候选、接受和最终纳入条目数见补充表 17。 冻结的实验共包含 3,662 个条目：1,366 个变异解读条目、1,253 个基因-疾病有效性条目和 1,043 个临床可操作性条目。

sents.en: Source-specific candidate, acceptance and final-inclusion counts are given in Supplementary Table 17 .

sents.en: The frozen experiment contained 3,662 items: 1,366 variant-interpretation, 1,253 gene–disease-validity and 1,043 clinical-actionability items.

paragraphs.en: Candidate units processed by the adversarial QA-generation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 由对抗式问答生成流水线处理的候选单元。

paragraphs.en: Items included in the frozen model-selection experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结模型选择实验中包含的项目。

paragraphs.en: The 3,849 accepted items are the complete output of the archived adversarial QA-generation batches. The model-selection total is 3,662 because the frozen experiment used 1,253 of the 1,440 accepted ClinGen Gene–Disease Validity items. ClinVar and ClinGen-ACMG were combined for the variant-interpretation radar plot; CIViC, OncoKB and PharmGKB/ClinPGx were combined for the clinical-actionability radar plot.
paragraphs.zh: 这 3,849 条已采纳条目是已归档的对抗式问答生成批次的完整输出。 模型选择的总数为 3,662，因为冻结实验使用了 1,440 条已采纳的 ClinGen 基因–疾病有效性条目中的 1,253 条。 ClinVar 与 ClinGen-ACMG 被合并用于变异解读雷达图；CIViC、OncoKB 和 PharmGKB/ClinPGx 被合并用于临床可操作性雷达图。

paragraphs.en: A source-specific generator produced a publication-grounded question, reference answer, reasoning annotation and supporting quotations. Items had to require interpretation or synthesis, and every quotation had to fuzzy-match the current full text at a similarity of at least 0.80.
paragraphs.zh: 针对每个来源的生成器产出了一个基于出版物的问题、参考答案、推理标注以及支持性引文。 题目必须要求解读或综合，且每条引文必须以至少 0.80 的相似度与当前全文进行模糊匹配。

sents.en: A source-specific generator produced a publication-grounded question, reference answer, reasoning annotation and supporting quotations.
sents.zh: 针对每个来源的生成器产出了一个基于出版物的问题、参考答案、推理标注以及支持性引文。

sents.en: Items had to require interpretation or synthesis, and every quotation had to fuzzy-match the current full text at a similarity of at least 0.80.
sents.zh: 题目必须要求解读或综合，且每条引文必须以至少 0.80 的相似度与当前全文进行模糊匹配。

paragraphs.en: Four memoryless answerers (DeepSeek-V4, Qwen3.7-Max, MiniMax-M3 and MiMo-V2.5-Pro) then answered from the same paper. A source-masked Qwen3.7-Plus arbiter from a different model family checked ambiguity, source support, overreach and semantic difficulty, returning discriminative acceptance, consensus-hard acceptance or rejection. Rejected units were regenerated for at most three quality attempts. Accepted audit records were retained but hidden from evaluated cores.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，四个无记忆的回答智能体（DeepSeek-V4、Qwen3.7-Max、MiniMax-M3 和 MiMo-V2.5-Pro）基于同一篇论文作答。 来自不同模型系列的源掩蔽 Qwen3.7-Plus 仲裁者检查歧义性、来源支持、过度引申和语义难度，并返回区分性接受、共识困难接受或拒绝。 被拒绝的单元最多重新生成三次质量尝试。 被接受的审计记录予以保留，但对被评估的核心隐藏。

sents.en: Four memoryless answerers (DeepSeek-V4, Qwen3.7-Max, MiniMax-M3 and MiMo-V2.5-Pro) then answered from the same paper.
sents.zh: 随后，四个无记忆的回答智能体（DeepSeek-V4、Qwen3.7-Max、MiniMax-M3 和 MiMo-V2.5-Pro）基于同一篇论文作答。

sents.en: A source-masked Qwen3.7-Plus arbiter from a different model family checked ambiguity, source support, overreach and semantic difficulty, returning discriminative acceptance, consensus-hard acceptance or rejection.

sents.en: Rejected units were regenerated for at most three quality attempts.
sents.zh: 被拒绝的单元最多重新生成三次质量尝试。

sents.en: Accepted audit records were retained but hidden from evaluated cores.
sents.zh: 被接受的审计记录予以保留，但对被评估的核心隐藏。

paragraphs.en: Each core received the question and retrieval entry points, not full text in the initial prompt, and used the same ClinGeX skills, tool definitions, 50-turn limit, timeout and retry policy. Runs retained the final answer, status and complete trace, including tool, skill, action, canonical parameters and result metadata.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体核心都接到了问题和检索入口，而非初始提示中的全文，并使用相同的 ClinGeX 技能、工具定义、50 轮上限、超时与重试策略。 运行过程保留了最终答案、状态和完整追踪，包括工具、技能、动作、规范参数和结果元数据。

sents.en: Each core received the question and retrieval entry points, not full text in the initial prompt, and used the same ClinGeX skills, tool definitions, 50-turn limit, timeout and retry policy.
sents.zh: 每个智能体核心都接到了问题和检索入口，而非初始提示中的全文，并使用相同的 ClinGeX 技能、工具定义、50 轮上限、超时与重试策略。

sents.en: Runs retained the final answer, status and complete trace, including tool, skill, action, canonical parameters and result metadata.
sents.zh: 运行过程保留了最终答案、状态和完整追踪，包括工具、技能、动作、规范参数和结果元数据。

paragraphs.en: Construction answerers, arbitration data, rejected attempts, generator rationale and target reasoning point were removed before inference; reference answers, quotations and source annotations were scoring-only. Every (model, item) pair was run independently three times without shared state, retrieved content or tool history.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理之前，构建型答题器、仲裁数据、被拒绝的尝试、生成理由和目标推理点均被移除；参考答案、引用和来源标注仅用于评分。 每个（模型，题目）对在无共享状态、无共享检索内容或工具历史的情况下独立运行三次。

sents.zh: 在推理之前，构建型答题器、仲裁数据、被拒绝的尝试、生成理由和目标推理点均被移除；参考答案、引用和来源标注仅用于评分。

sents.en: Every (model, item) pair was run independently three times without shared state, retrieved content or tool history.
sents.zh: 每个（模型，题目）对在无共享状态、无共享检索内容或工具历史的情况下独立运行三次。

paragraphs.en: The five dimensions combined external-judge assessment of the response with judge-free analysis of the execution trace. The external judge was not one of the six candidate cores.
paragraphs.zh: 这五个维度将外部评审对回复的评估与对执行轨迹的免评审分析相结合。 外部评审并非六个候选核心之一。

sents.zh: 这五个维度将外部评审对回复的评估与对执行轨迹的免评审分析相结合。

sents.en: The external judge was not one of the six candidate cores.
sents.zh: 外部评审并非六个候选核心之一。

paragraphs.en: Each reference answer was cached as atomic claims. The item score was 1 when all claims were supported, 0.5 when at least half were supported, and 0 otherwise; contradiction of the critical target claim forced a score of 0. Thus, accuracy was a deterministic 0/0.5/1 claim-coverage score rather than string matching.
paragraphs.zh: 每个参考答案都被缓存为原子性论断。 当所有论断都被支持时，条目得分为 1；当至少一半被支持时为 0.5；否则为 0；若关键目标论断被反驳，则强制得分为 0。 因此，准确率是一个确定性的 0/0.5/1 论断覆盖率得分，而非字符串匹配。

sents.en: Each reference answer was cached as atomic claims.
sents.zh: 每个参考答案都被缓存为原子性论断。

sents.en: The item score was 1 when all claims were supported, 0.5 when at least half were supported, and 0 otherwise; contradiction of the critical target claim forced a score of 0.

sents.zh: 因此，准确率是一个确定性的 0/0.5/1 论断覆盖率得分，而非字符串匹配。

paragraphs.en: Five binary indicators assessed specific evidence use, recognition of the hidden reasoning issue, logical connection of evidence to conclusion, coverage of all requested parts and consistency between rationale and answer. Their sum ranged from 0 to 5.
paragraphs.zh: 五个二元指标分别评估了证据的具体使用情况、对隐藏推理问题的识别、证据与结论之间的逻辑联系、是否覆盖所有要求的部分，以及理由与答案之间的一致性。 它们的总分范围为 0 到 5 分。

sents.en: Five binary indicators assessed specific evidence use, recognition of the hidden reasoning issue, logical connection of evidence to conclusion, coverage of all requested parts and consistency between rationale and answer.
sents.zh: 五个二元指标分别评估了证据的具体使用情况、对隐藏推理问题的识别、证据与结论之间的逻辑联系、是否覆盖所有要求的部分，以及理由与答案之间的一致性。

sents.en: Their sum ranged from 0 to 5.
sents.zh: 它们的总分范围为 0 到 5 分。

paragraphs.en: Three judge-free trace statistics captured execution effort and reliability: tool-call count T T , failed-call rate f f and exact-duplicate rate d d , where duplicates shared the same skill, action and canonical parameters. Values were averaged across the three runs and, for multi-source domains, across sources with equal weight. For the radar axis, each statistic was reverse min–max normalized across the six models within a domain and combined as G m = ( Z m , T + Z m , f + Z m , d ) / 3 G_{m}=(Z_{m,T}+Z_{m,f}+Z_{m,d})/3 . Raw statistics were retained because call count alone was not interpreted as quality.
paragraphs.zh: 三个无需评判者的轨迹统计量刻画了执行投入与可靠性：工具调用次数 T T、失败调用率 f f 与完全重复率 d d，其中重复指共享相同技能、动作与规范化参数。 数值在三次运行间取平均，对于多来源领域，再对来源以相等权重取平均。 对于雷达图坐标轴，每个统计量都在同一领域内的六个模型间进行反向最小–最大归一化，并按 G m = ( Z m , T + Z m , f + Z m , d ) / 3 G_{m}=(Z_{m,T}+Z_{m,f}+Z_{m,d})/3 组合。 保留原始统计量是因为调用次数本身并未被解读为质量。

paragraphs.en: Direct quotations were fuzzy-matched to retrieved text; other concrete claims were labelled supported, contradicted or unverifiable against retrieved evidence. With fabricated-quotation rate q i q_{i} and contradicted-or-unverifiable factual-claim rate h i h_{i} , faithfulness was H i = 1 − 0.5 ​ q i − 0.5 ​ h i H_{i}=1-0.5q_{i}-0.5h_{i} . Errors affecting key values, evidence levels, clinical scope or conclusions were additionally flagged as high severity.
