sents.zh: 影响关键数值、证据等级、临床范围或结论的错误还被额外标注为高严重性。

paragraphs.en: Across three independent runs, answer consistency C i C_{i} was 1 when all accuracy scores agreed, 0.5 when two agreed and 0 otherwise. Tool-sequence similarity U i U_{i} was the mean pairwise Levenshtein similarity of (skill, action) sequences; agentic stability V i V_{i} was one minus the mean coefficient of variation of tool, failed and duplicate-call counts, truncated at zero. The composite was B i = 0.4 ​ C i + 0.3 ​ U i + 0.3 ​ V i B_{i}=0.4C_{i}+0.3U_{i}+0.3V_{i} .
paragraphs.zh: 在三次独立运行中，当所有准确率得分一致时，答案一致性 C i C_{i} 为 1，当两者一致时为 0.5，否则为 0。 工具序列相似度 U i U_{i} 取（技能, 动作）序列的成对 Levenshtein 相似度的均值；智能体稳定性 V i V_{i} 取 1 减去工具调用次数、失败调用次数和重复调用次数的平均变异系数，并在零处截断。 综合指标为 B i = 0.4 ​ C i + 0.3 ​ U i + 0.3 ​ V i B_{i}=0.4C_{i}+0.3U_{i}+0.3V_{i} 。

sents.en: Across three independent runs, answer consistency C i C_{i} was 1 when all accuracy scores agreed, 0.5 when two agreed and 0 otherwise.
sents.zh: 在三次独立运行中，当所有准确率得分一致时，答案一致性 C i C_{i} 为 1，当两者一致时为 0.5，否则为 0。

sents.en: Tool-sequence similarity U i U_{i} was the mean pairwise Levenshtein similarity of (skill, action) sequences; agentic stability V i V_{i} was one minus the mean coefficient of variation of tool, failed and duplicate-call counts, truncated at zero.
sents.zh: 工具序列相似度 U i U_{i} 取（技能, 动作）序列的成对 Levenshtein 相似度的均值；智能体稳定性 V i V_{i} 取 1 减去工具调用次数、失败调用次数和重复调用次数的平均变异系数，并在零处截断。

sents.en: The composite was B i = 0.4 ​ C i + 0.3 ​ U i + 0.3 ​ V i B_{i}=0.4C_{i}+0.3U_{i}+0.3V_{i} .

paragraphs.en: Reference claims were decomposed once per item and reused for every model and run. The source-masked prompt below separately elicits claim correctness, five reasoning indicators and factual-faithfulness labels; candidate models never received the reference-only fields.
paragraphs.zh: 参考声明按条目仅分解一次，并在所有模型和每次运行中重复使用。 下面的源掩蔽提示分别引出声明正确性、五个推理指标和事实忠实度标签；候选模型从未收到仅含参考内容的字段。

sents.en: Reference claims were decomposed once per item and reused for every model and run.
sents.zh: 参考声明按条目仅分解一次，并在所有模型和每次运行中重复使用。

sents.en: The source-masked prompt below separately elicits claim correctness, five reasoning indicators and factual-faithfulness labels; candidate models never received the reference-only fields.
sents.zh: 下面的源掩蔽提示分别引出声明正确性、五个推理指标和事实忠实度标签；候选模型从未收到仅含参考内容的字段。

paragraphs.en: The scoring code validated the returned schema, summed the five reasoning indicators, applied the deterministic accuracy thresholds and combined the faithfulness labels with the independent quotation-matching result. The judge was not given the candidate model name.
paragraphs.zh: 评分代码验证了返回的模式，将五个推理指标求和，应用了确定性的准确性阈值，并将忠实度标签与独立的引文匹配结果相结合。 评审程序没有获知候选模型的名称。

sents.en: The scoring code validated the returned schema, summed the five reasoning indicators, applied the deterministic accuracy thresholds and combined the faithfulness labels with the independent quotation-matching result.
sents.zh: 评分代码验证了返回的模式，将五个推理指标求和，应用了确定性的准确性阈值，并将忠实度标签与独立的引文匹配结果相结合。

sents.en: The judge was not given the candidate model name.
sents.zh: 评审程序没有获知候选模型的名称。

paragraphs.en: The details below supplement the main study design. The analysis unit was a submitted case assessment; reader-facing materials never contained reference answers, scoring annotations or adjudication records.
paragraphs.zh: 以下细节是对主研究设计的补充。 分析单位为提交的病例评估；面向阅片者的材料中绝不包含参考答案、评分注释或裁定记录。

sents.en: The details below supplement the main study design.
sents.zh: 以下细节是对主研究设计的补充。

sents.en: The analysis unit was a submitted case assessment; reader-facing materials never contained reference answers, scoring annotations or adjudication records.
sents.zh: 分析单位为提交的病例评估；面向阅片者的材料中绝不包含参考答案、评分注释或裁定记录。

paragraphs.en: The password-protected platform linked each account to nine fixed task–condition assignments and presented de-identified case materials beside the scenario-specific response form. Reference answers, scoring keys, other readers’ responses and alternate-condition responses to the same case were inaccessible. Readers used no AI in the unassisted condition or consulted the assigned external DeepSeek/ClinGeX interface before entering their own conclusion; AI output was never copied automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 该密码保护平台将每个账户与九项固定的任务—条件分配绑定，并在情境专用作答表旁呈现去标识化的病例材料。 参考答案、评分要点、其他阅读者的作答以及同一病例在备选条件下的作答均不可访问。 阅读者在无辅助条件下不使用任何 AI，或在输入自己的结论之前查阅被指定的外部 DeepSeek/ClinGeX 接口；AI 输出绝不会被自动复制。

sents.en: The password-protected platform linked each account to nine fixed task–condition assignments and presented de-identified case materials beside the scenario-specific response form.
sents.zh: 该密码保护平台将每个账户与九项固定的任务—条件分配绑定，并在情境专用作答表旁呈现去标识化的病例材料。

sents.en: Reference answers, scoring keys, other readers’ responses and alternate-condition responses to the same case were inaccessible.
sents.zh: 参考答案、评分要点、其他阅读者的作答以及同一病例在备选条件下的作答均不可访问。

sents.en: Readers used no AI in the unassisted condition or consulted the assigned external DeepSeek/ClinGeX interface before entering their own conclusion; AI output was never copied automatically.
sents.zh: 阅读者在无辅助条件下不使用任何 AI，或在输入自己的结论之前查阅被指定的外部 DeepSeek/ClinGeX 接口；AI 输出绝不会被自动复制。

paragraphs.en: Drafts were retained, required fields were checked on submission and oncology readers completed the open response before viewing candidate statements. Completion time was self-reported rather than inferred from browser duration. Scenario fields are listed in Supplementary Table 18 ; five-level confidence was encoded 1–5 from no confidence to very confident.
paragraphs.zh: 保留了草稿，提交时检查了必填字段，肿瘤学读者在查看候选声明之前完成了开放式回答。 完成时间为自我报告，而非根据浏览器时长推断得出。 情景字段列于补充表 18；五级置信度编码为 1–5，从无信心到非常有信心。

sents.en: Drafts were retained, required fields were checked on submission and oncology readers completed the open response before viewing candidate statements.
sents.zh: 保留了草稿，提交时检查了必填字段，肿瘤学读者在查看候选声明之前完成了开放式回答。

sents.en: Completion time was self-reported rather than inferred from browser duration.
sents.zh: 完成时间为自我报告，而非根据浏览器时长推断得出。

sents.en: Scenario fields are listed in Supplementary Table 18 ; five-level confidence was encoded 1–5 from no confidence to very confident.
sents.zh: 情景字段列于补充表 18；五级置信度编码为 1–5，从无信心到非常有信心。

paragraphs.en: Before analysis, each three-member scenario panel froze a reference record matching the reader fields: final classification, ACMG/AMP criteria and strengths for criterion-level variant analysis; candidate pathogenicity, phenotype explanation and acceptable adjacent levels for genomic interpretation in rare disease; and a core open answer plus graded candidate statements for molecular oncology decision-making. Enumerated fields were compared by prespecified mappings, while free text and borderline cases were resolved by source-masked panel consensus based on clinical equivalence rather than wording or response length.
paragraphs.zh: 在分析之前，每个三人场景小组均冻结了一份与读者字段相匹配的参考记录：在标准级别的变异分析中使用最终分类及ACMG/AMP证据与强度；在罕见病的基因组解读中使用候选致病性、表型解释及可接受的相邻级别；在分子肿瘤学决策中使用核心开放性答案及分级候选陈述。 枚举型字段按预先设定的映射进行比较，而自由文本和边界病例则由在源答案遮蔽情况下的专家组基于临床等效性（而非措辞或回答长度）达成共识后裁定。

sents.en: Before analysis, each three-member scenario panel froze a reference record matching the reader fields: final classification, ACMG/AMP criteria and strengths for criterion-level variant analysis; candidate pathogenicity, phenotype explanation and acceptable adjacent levels for genomic interpretation in rare disease; and a core open answer plus graded candidate statements for molecular oncology decision-making.
sents.zh: 在分析之前，每个三人场景小组均冻结了一份与读者字段相匹配的参考记录：在标准级别的变异分析中使用最终分类及ACMG/AMP证据与强度；在罕见病的基因组解读中使用候选致病性、表型解释及可接受的相邻级别；在分子肿瘤学决策中使用核心开放性答案及分级候选陈述。

sents.en: Enumerated fields were compared by prespecified mappings, while free text and borderline cases were resolved by source-masked panel consensus based on clinical equivalence rather than wording or response length.
sents.zh: 枚举型字段按预先设定的映射进行比较，而自由文本和边界病例则由在源答案遮蔽情况下的专家组基于临床等效性（而非措辞或回答长度）达成共识后裁定。

paragraphs.en: For each scenario and condition, concordance was the proportion of the 45 submitted assessments satisfying the complete task-specific rule in Supplementary Table 19 ; no pooled primary outcome combined the three scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每种情景和条件，一致性是指45份提交的评估中满足补充表19中完整任务特定规则的比例；没有合并主要结局将三种情景合并在一起。

paragraphs.en: Secondary outcomes isolated the structured reasoning components listed with their units and denominators in Supplementary Table 20 ; eligible item instances were micro-averaged within condition.
paragraphs.zh: 次要结局分离出所列的结构化推理成分，其单位与分母见补充表 20；符合条件的条目实例在各条件下进行微平均。

paragraphs.en: For criterion-level variant analysis, evidence recall was ∑ i | G i ∩ P i | / ∑ i | G i | \sum_{i}|G_{i}\cap P_{i}|/\sum_{i}|G_{i}| , unsupported-evidence assignment was ∑ i | P i ∖ G i | / ∑ i | P i | \sum_{i}|P_{i}\setminus G_{i}|/\sum_{i}|P_{i}| , and strength concordance required an exact strength match among recalled reference criteria. The second metric is labelled the evidence hallucination rate in the figure and code, but denotes an unsupported ACMG/AMP criterion rather than a fabricated citation. Final-class accuracy and directional over-/underestimation used the ordered five-tier pathogenicity scale; the reference contained 176 criterion instances.
paragraphs.zh: 在判据级别的变异分析中，证据召回率为 ∑ i | G i ∩ P i | / ∑ i | G i | \sum_{i}|G_{i}\cap P_{i}|/\sum_{i}|G_{i}|，无支持证据分配率为 ∑ i | P i ∖ G i | / ∑ i | P i | \sum_{i}|P_{i}\setminus G_{i}|/\sum_{i}|P_{i}|，而强度一致性要求在召回的参考判据中强度完全匹配。 第二项指标在图和代码中标注为证据幻觉率，但其含义是无支持的 ACMG/AMP 判据，而非虚构的引文。 最终分类准确率以及方向性的高估/低估采用了有序的五级致病性量表；参考标准共包含 176 个判据实例。

sents.en: For criterion-level variant analysis, evidence recall was ∑ i | G i ∩ P i | / ∑ i | G i | \sum_{i}|G_{i}\cap P_{i}|/\sum_{i}|G_{i}| , unsupported-evidence assignment was ∑ i | P i ∖ G i | / ∑ i | P i | \sum_{i}|P_{i}\setminus G_{i}|/\sum_{i}|P_{i}| , and strength concordance required an exact strength match among recalled reference criteria.
sents.zh: 在判据级别的变异分析中，证据召回率为 ∑ i | G i ∩ P i | / ∑ i | G i | \sum_{i}|G_{i}\cap P_{i}|/\sum_{i}|G_{i}|，无支持证据分配率为 ∑ i | P i ∖ G i | / ∑ i | P i | \sum_{i}|P_{i}\setminus G_{i}|/\sum_{i}|P_{i}|，而强度一致性要求在召回的参考判据中强度完全匹配。

sents.en: The second metric is labelled the evidence hallucination rate in the figure and code, but denotes an unsupported ACMG/AMP criterion rather than a fabricated citation.
sents.zh: 第二项指标在图和代码中标注为证据幻觉率，但其含义是无支持的 ACMG/AMP 判据，而非虚构的引文。

sents.en: Final-class accuracy and directional over-/underestimation used the ordered five-tier pathogenicity scale; the reference contained 176 criterion instances.
sents.zh: 最终分类准确率以及方向性的高估/低估采用了有序的五级致病性量表；参考标准共包含 176 个判据实例。

paragraphs.en: For genomic interpretation in rare disease, the 117 candidate variants were evaluated for exact pathogenicity, directional error and phenotype-explanation accuracy. Phenotype accuracy allowed an accepted adjacent level only when the substantive interpretation was preserved; over-/underestimation was measured beyond this accepted range. Primary concordance additionally required the correct causal combination and inheritance interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 在罕见病的基因组解读中，对117个候选变异评估了精确致病性、方向性误差以及表型解释准确性。 仅当实质性解读得以保留时，表型准确性才允许接受相邻层级；超出此接受范围的高估/低估均被测量。 主要一致性还要求正确的因果组合及遗传方式解读。

sents.en: For genomic interpretation in rare disease, the 117 candidate variants were evaluated for exact pathogenicity, directional error and phenotype-explanation accuracy.
sents.zh: 在罕见病的基因组解读中，对117个候选变异评估了精确致病性、方向性误差以及表型解释准确性。

sents.en: Phenotype accuracy allowed an accepted adjacent level only when the substantive interpretation was preserved; over-/underestimation was measured beyond this accepted range.
sents.zh: 仅当实质性解读得以保留时，表型准确性才允许接受相邻层级；超出此接受范围的高估/低估均被测量。

sents.en: Primary concordance additionally required the correct causal combination and inheritance interpretation.
sents.zh: 主要一致性还要求正确的因果组合及遗传方式解读。

paragraphs.en: For molecular oncology decision-making, free-response accuracy used panel-adjudicated agreement with the core answer across 45 cases. The four statements per case produced 180 judgements; accuracy required the reference clinical position, while over-/underestimation followed the ordered unreasonable–partly reasonable–basically reasonable scale and did not tolerate a supported–unsupported boundary crossing.
paragraphs.zh: 在分子肿瘤学决策方面，自由作答的准确性采用专家组裁定的与核心答案一致性的方式，在45个病例上进行评估。 每个病例包含四条陈述，共产生180个判断；准确性要求达到参考临床立场，而高估/低估则遵循“不合理—部分合理—基本合理”的有序量表，且不允许跨过“有依据—无依据”的界限。

sents.en: For molecular oncology decision-making, free-response accuracy used panel-adjudicated agreement with the core answer across 45 cases.
sents.zh: 在分子肿瘤学决策方面，自由作答的准确性采用专家组裁定的与核心答案一致性的方式，在45个病例上进行评估。

sents.en: The four statements per case produced 180 judgements; accuracy required the reference clinical position, while over-/underestimation followed the ordered unreasonable–partly reasonable–basically reasonable scale and did not tolerate a supported–unsupported boundary crossing.
sents.zh: 每个病例包含四条陈述，共产生180个判断；准确性要求达到参考临床立场，而高估/低估则遵循“不合理—部分合理—基本合理”的有序量表，且不允许跨过“有依据—无依据”的界限。

paragraphs.en: For criterion-level variant analysis, behavioural certainty was full when all 28 ACMG/AMP criteria had an explicit applicable/not-applicable call and partial when any remained undetermined. Group accuracy used exact final pathogenicity classification, not the stricter primary composite; Wilson intervals were descriptive because fully certain groups were small.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准层面的变异分析中，当全部 28 条 ACMG/AMP 标准均有明确的「适用/不适用」判定时，行为确定性记为完全；若仍有任何标准未确定，则记为部分。 组级准确性采用最终的致病性分类的精确匹配，而非更严格的主要复合指标；由于完全确定的组数量较少，Wilson 区间仅为描述性用途。

sents.en: For criterion-level variant analysis, behavioural certainty was full when all 28 ACMG/AMP criteria had an explicit applicable/not-applicable call and partial when any remained undetermined.
sents.zh: 在标准层面的变异分析中，当全部 28 条 ACMG/AMP 标准均有明确的「适用/不适用」判定时，行为确定性记为完全；若仍有任何标准未确定，则记为部分。

sents.en: Group accuracy used exact final pathogenicity classification, not the stricter primary composite; Wilson intervals were descriptive because fully certain groups were small.
sents.zh: 组级准确性采用最终的致病性分类的精确匹配，而非更严格的主要复合指标；由于完全确定的组数量较少，Wilson 区间仅为描述性用途。

paragraphs.en: For genomic interpretation in rare disease, correctness was primary case-level concordance; for molecular oncology decision-making, it was correctness of the open answer entered immediately before confidence. Five-level confidence was related to correctness using point-biserial correlation and ROC–AUC. Positive correlation and AUC above 0.5 indicate discrimination.
paragraphs.zh: 对于罕见病的基因组解读，正确性主要指病例层面的一致性；对于分子肿瘤学的决策，正确性指在填写置信度之前立即输入的开放式答案的正确性。 使用点二列相关和ROC–AUC将五级置信度与正确性相关联。 正相关及AUC高于0.5表明具有区分能力。

sents.en: For genomic interpretation in rare disease, correctness was primary case-level concordance; for molecular oncology decision-making, it was correctness of the open answer entered immediately before confidence.
sents.zh: 对于罕见病的基因组解读，正确性主要指病例层面的一致性；对于分子肿瘤学的决策，正确性指在填写置信度之前立即输入的开放式答案的正确性。

sents.en: Five-level confidence was related to correctness using point-biserial correlation and ROC–AUC.
sents.zh: 使用点二列相关和ROC–AUC将五级置信度与正确性相关联。

sents.en: Positive correlation and AUC above 0.5 indicate discrimination.
sents.zh: 正相关及AUC高于0.5表明具有区分能力。

paragraphs.en: Confidence categories were mapped to probabilities 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 and 0.9 for the Brier score, N − 1 ​ ∑ i ( q i − Y i ) 2 N^{-1}\sum_{i}(q_{i}-Y_{i})^{2} ; correlation and AUC retained the original ordinal scores. Expected calibration error was descriptive, with no model fitting or threshold optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 置信度类别被映射为概率 0.1、0.3、0.5、0.7 和 0.9，用于计算 Brier 分数 N − 1 ​ ∑ i ( q i − Y i ) 2 N^{-1}\sum_{i}(q_{i}-Y_{i})^{2}；相关性和 AUC 则保留原始的有序评分。 期望校准误差仅作描述性用途，不涉及模型拟合或阈值优化。

sents.en: Confidence categories were mapped to probabilities 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 and 0.9 for the Brier score, N − 1 ​ ∑ i ( q i − Y i ) 2 N^{-1}\sum_{i}(q_{i}-Y_{i})^{2} ; correlation and AUC retained the original ordinal scores.
sents.zh: 置信度类别被映射为概率 0.1、0.3、0.5、0.7 和 0.9，用于计算 Brier 分数 N − 1 ​ ∑ i ( q i − Y i ) 2 N^{-1}\sum_{i}(q_{i}-Y_{i})^{2}；相关性和 AUC 则保留原始的有序评分。

sents.en: Expected calibration error was descriptive, with no model fitting or threshold optimization.
sents.zh: 期望校准误差仅作描述性用途，不涉及模型拟合或阈值优化。

paragraphs.en: The main time comparison used each reader’s post-study estimate of mean minutes per case, not browser-open duration or the case-form field. Paired two-sided Wilcoxon tests within scenario were Holm-adjusted, and medians were reported.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的时间比较使用了每位读者研究后估计的每例平均分钟数，而非浏览器打开时长或病例表单字段。 各场景内采用配对双侧 Wilcoxon 检验并进行 Holm 校正，同时报告中位数。

sents.en: The main time comparison used each reader’s post-study estimate of mean minutes per case, not browser-open duration or the case-form field.
sents.zh: 主要的时间比较使用了每位读者研究后估计的每例平均分钟数，而非浏览器打开时长或病例表单字段。

sents.en: Paired two-sided Wilcoxon tests within scenario were Holm-adjusted, and medians were reported.
sents.zh: 各场景内采用配对双侧 Wilcoxon 检验并进行 Holm 校正，同时报告中位数。

paragraphs.en: The questionnaire comprised three time items and five ordinal dimensions rated separately for DeepSeek and ClinGeX; ratings were summarized by mean and standard deviation. Continued use was the number of new ClinGeX conversations initiated in the 14 days after completion, excluding three assigned study sessions, and was analysed descriptively without hypothesis testing.
paragraphs.zh: 问卷包含三个时间项目和五个顺序维度，分别针对 DeepSeek 和 ClinGeX 进行评分；评分结果以均值和标准差进行汇总。 持续使用情况指完成研究后 14 天内发起新的 ClinGeX 对话的次数，不包括三次分配的研究会话，并采用描述性分析，不进行假设检验。

sents.en: The questionnaire comprised three time items and five ordinal dimensions rated separately for DeepSeek and ClinGeX; ratings were summarized by mean and standard deviation.
sents.zh: 问卷包含三个时间项目和五个顺序维度，分别针对 DeepSeek 和 ClinGeX 进行评分；评分结果以均值和标准差进行汇总。

sents.en: Continued use was the number of new ClinGeX conversations initiated in the 14 days after completion, excluding three assigned study sessions, and was analysed descriptively without hypothesis testing.
sents.zh: 持续使用情况指完成研究后 14 天内发起新的 ClinGeX 对话的次数，不包括三次分配的研究会话，并采用描述性分析，不进行假设检验。

paragraphs.en: Observed numerators and denominators were retained for descriptive reporting. For each scenario and outcome, condition effects were estimated using a binomial logistic GLMM with condition as a fixed effect and crossed random intercepts for reader and case. Case-level binary outcomes were entered as success or failure; item-level outcomes were grouped within each reader–case assessment as cbind(success, total-success) , thereby retaining their observed denominators. Accuracy, overestimation and underestimation were analysed as separate binary outcomes. Model-standardized probabilities and absolute between-condition differences in percentage points were obtained by integrating over the estimated reader- and case-level random-effect distributions, with two-sided 95% Wald confidence intervals. For outcomes where lower values were favourable, figures show one minus the model-standardized event probability and the direction of each contrast was reversed. Pairwise Wald contrasts were Holm-adjusted across the three comparisons within each outcome and scenario; the corresponding two-degree-of-freedom omnibus Wald test was descriptive only. Random slopes were not fitted because each reader contributed only three assessments per condition within a scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 保留观察到的分子和分母用于描述性报告。 对每个情境和结局，采用二项logistic广义线性混合模型（GLMM）估计条件效应，其中条件作为固定效应，读者和病例采用交叉随机截距。 病例层面的二分类结局以成功或失败形式纳入；条目层面的结局在每个读者–病例评估内以 cbind(成功, 总数−成功) 的形式分组，从而保留其观察到的分母。 准确性、高估和低估分别作为独立的二分类结局进行分析。 通过对估计的读者层面和病例层面随机效应分布进行积分，获得模型标准化概率及条件间以百分点表示的绝对差异，并给出双侧95% Wald置信区间。 对于数值越低越好的结局，图中展示1减去模型标准化事件概率的结果，且每个对比的方向被反向处理。 两两Wald对比在每个结局和情境内的三个比较中进行了Holm校正；相应的两自由度总体Wald检验仅作描述性用途。 由于每位读者在每个情境内每种条件下仅提供三次评估，因此未拟合随机斜率。

paragraphs.en: The 323 human molecular-oncology case reports identified in the main Methods—186 digestive-system and 137 thoracic-tumour reports published after 2025—were processed independently before expert selection. GPT-5.5 read each complete report and returned structured fields comprising the clinically decisive or counterintuitive features, their clinical implication, a de-identified vignette, one direct question, a concise core answer and explicit scoring points. Vignettes retained the clinical, pathological, treatment and molecular facts needed to answer the question, but omitted article titles, authors, journals, identifiers and source-revealing wording.
paragraphs.zh: 在主要方法部分确定的323份人类分子肿瘤学病例报告——即2025年之后发表的186份消化系统和137份胸部肿瘤报告——在专家筛选之前被独立处理。 GPT-5.5阅读每份完整报告并返回结构化字段，包括具有临床决定性或反直觉的特征、其临床意义、一段去标识化的病例摘要、一个直接提问、一个简明的核心答案以及明确的评分要点。 病例摘要保留了回答问题所需的临床、病理、治疗和分子层面的事实，但省略了文章标题、作者、期刊、标识符以及可能暴露来源的措辞。

paragraphs.en: Five independent models—DeepSeek-V4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, GLM-5.1 and Qwen3.7—then answered each vignette and question in fresh contexts without access to the report, reference answer or other model responses. Claude Opus 4.8 subsequently assessed whether the reference was source-grounded and clinically defensible; whether the vignette was self-contained and free of answer or publication leakage; whether the question was single, direct and appropriate for a practising oncologist; and whether the simulated responses demonstrated useful discriminatory difficulty. Failed items were regenerated by GPT-5.5 using the arbitrator’s written feedback and rerun through independent answering and arbitration, for at most five generation rounds. Reports without an acceptable task were discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，五个独立的模型——DeepSeek-V4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4、GLM-5.1 和 Qwen3.7——在全新上下文中回答每个情景短例和问题，且无法访问报告、参考答案或其他模型的回答。 Claude Opus 4.8 随后评估参考答案是否有原文依据且在临床上站得住脚；情景短例是否自成一体且不含答案或发表信息泄露；问题是否单一、直接且适合执业肿瘤科医生；以及模拟回答是否展现出有区分度且具有一定难度的价值。 未通过审查的条目由 GPT-5.5 根据仲裁者的书面反馈重新生成，并重新经过独立的作答与仲裁流程，最多生成五轮。 没有可接受任务的报告被弃用。

paragraphs.en: For each accepted open question, the reference conclusion supplied the best-supported of four candidate statements, while incorrect or partially correct model responses were used to construct clinically plausible alternatives. Each statement received a hidden five-point truth grade: grades 4–5 mapped to basically reasonable , grade 3 to partly reasonable , and grades 1–2 to unreasonable . Statement order was randomized. A final validation pass required consistency between the core answer and statement grades, exactly one best-supported statement, defensible distractors and no superficial answer cue from length, tone, certainty or absolute wording. The reader-facing task contained only the vignette, question and statements; source reports, scoring points, truth grades, simulated answers and revision records were retained separately for audit and adjudication.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个被采纳的开放性问题，参考结论提供了四个候选陈述中最有依据的一个，而错误或部分正确的模型回答则被用于构建临床上合理的替代选项。 每个陈述都被赋予一个隐藏的五分真值评分：4–5 分对应基本合理，3 分对应部分合理，1–2 分对应不合理。 陈述的顺序经过随机化处理。 最终的校验环节要求核心答案与各陈述评分保持一致，有且仅有一个最有依据的陈述，干扰项须言之成理，且不得从长度、语气、确定性或绝对化措辞中泄露表面上的答案线索。 面向读者的任务内容仅包含病例情景、问题和陈述；来源报告、评分要点、真值评分、模拟回答及修订记录则单独留存，以供审计与裁定之用。

paragraphs.en: The automated pipeline produced 36 digestive-system and 26 thoracic-tumour candidates. A three-member oncology panel completed and reviewed every candidate for clinical relevance, objectivity, answer defensibility, difficulty, actionability, leakage risk and the plausibility and grading of all statements. The panel retained 27 digestive-system and 18 thoracic-tumour tasks, yielding the final 45, and could correct the core answer, statement wording or reference grades before the scoring record was frozen. Finally, the selected vignettes were manually de-identified: nonessential details and publication-revealing phrases were removed or reformulated, but no fact required to answer the clinical question was deleted.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化流程产出了 36 个消化系统与 26 个胸部肿瘤候选病例。 由三名成员组成的肿瘤学专家小组对每个候选病例进行了审阅与完善，评估其临床相关性、客观性、答案可辩护性、难度、可操作性、泄露风险以及所有陈述的合理性与分级。 该专家小组最终保留了 27 个消化系统与 18 个胸部肿瘤任务，形成最终的 45 个，并在评分记录冻结之前可对核心答案、陈述措辞或参考文献分级进行修正。 最后，选定的小病历进行了人工去标识化：删除或改写了非必要的细节以及可能暴露出处的表述，但没有删除回答临床问题所需的任何事实。

paragraphs.en: To assess the completeness of episode-level feedback, we counted all platform conversations recorded for each participant during the deployment period. A conversation was one platform session and could contain multiple dialogue turns. Feedback was submitted per completed analysis episode, and one episode could span multiple conversations. To preserve participant privacy, we did not inspect conversation content and therefore could not determine whether conversations without associated feedback were outside the study scope or represented eligible episodes for which feedback was not submitted. We therefore treated the ratio of feedback submissions to conversations as a conservative lower-bound proxy for episode-level feedback coverage, rather than as a one-to-one response rate. Overall, 96 feedback submissions were recorded for 111 conversations (86.5%); participant-level ratios ranged from 66.7% to 100% (Supplementary Table 21 ). This high lower-bound coverage was consistent with participants generally following the requested feedback procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估回合级反馈的完整性，我们统计了部署期间为每位参与者记录的所有平台会话。 一次会话指一次平台使用过程，其中可包含多轮对话。 反馈按完成的单个分析回合提交，而一个回合可能跨越多次会话。 为保护参与者隐私，我们未查看会话内容，因此无法判断没有关联反馈的会话是超出了研究范围，还是属于未提交反馈的符合条件回合。 因此，我们将反馈提交数与会话数之比视为回合级反馈覆盖率的保守下界代理指标，而非一对一的应答率。 总体而言，111 次会话共记录到 96 份反馈提交（86.5%）；参与者层面的比率介于 66.7% 至 100% 之间（补充表 21）。 这一较高的下界覆盖率表明参与者基本遵循了所要求的反馈流程。
